scope: P1 observed aircraft and mission-system performance for WVR/BVR-relevant engineering evaluation; excludes weapon employment envelopes, launch/release optimization, Pk, tactical recommendations and combat decision automation.

common_rules.time: Session Time is authoritative for computation; all source clocks require explicit TimeTransform.
common_rules.windows: Half-open [start,end); gaps, mode changes and validity boundaries split windows.
common_rules.reference_truth: Ownship+target navigation-derived relative state is REFERENCE_TRUTH, not absolute truth; uncertainty must accompany comparison.
common_rules.statistics: Metric algorithm contract owns the estimator/filter/operator family, numerator/denominator semantics, event-state machine, coordinate convention and output semantics. An Evaluation Profile may set only parameters explicitly declared by the metric (for example numeric thresholds, window duration, max_gap, min_coverage, persistence duration, band edges or reporting quantiles). A Profile MUST NOT select an alternative formula, estimator family, filter topology/order, numerator/denominator definition or output field set. Any algorithm-logic change requires a new algorithm_version and metric-definition version; if comparability changes, semantic_version must also change.
common_rules.missing: Missing prerequisite data => N_A or INSUFFICIENT_DATA with reason code; never fabricate zero.
common_rules.safety_boundary: No weapon performance envelope, best launch/release geometry, probability-of-kill modeling, tactical optimization or engagement recommendation is derived from this catalog.
common_rules.algorithm_identity: Every metric has exactly one algorithm_id + algorithm_version. The pair is immutable inside a released Metric Definition. Profile parameters are part of provenance/comparison_key but never substitute for algorithm identity.
common_rules.profile_boundary: Allowed profile controls are eligibility thresholds and declared numeric parameters only. Forbidden profile controls include formula choice, estimator choice, filter family/order, reference-frame convention, event numerator/denominator semantics and output schema.
common_rules.trend_subject_compatibility: P1 longitudinal longitudinal subject types are AIRCRAFT and MISSION_SYSTEM_INSTANCE only. Any metric with subject_type=TARGET_PAIR is reference/evaluation-quality evidence and MUST have p1_longitudinal_trend_eligibility=false; its quality/uncertainty travels with the owning mission-system observation/sample rather than creating a TARGET_PAIR trend lane.
common_rules.algorithm_dependency_closure: Every formula dependency that is not a raw/canonical input must be declared in operator_bindings, constant_bindings, upstream_dependencies or state_machine_bindings. Registry references are immutable/versioned. Unbound derivative/smoothing/filter/sustained-window/epsilon/reset/stable/qualified/association/handover semantics are forbidden.
common_rules.derived_operator_binding: Derivative/filter/smoothing/rolling/statistical operators must bind to operator_registry IDs when the implementation has nontrivial method choice. Sustained metrics must bind ROLLING_MEDIAN_V1 and declare sustain_duration_s/min_coverage/max_gap_us.
common_rules.constant_binding: Algorithm constants that affect eligibility/numerical behavior must use constant_registry IDs or literal values with units in formula. Bare epsilon is forbidden.
common_rules.state_machine_binding: Metrics using stable/qualified/reset/refuel/drop/reacquire/association/handover/opportunity semantics must consume a frozen upstream state/event or bind a state_machine_registry ID; the metric may not invent an unstated state machine. A metric that itself produces/qualifies a state must declare that state machine's numeric parameters; a downstream consumer may instead consume a pre-qualified upstream state/event whose producer/version is present in upstream_dependencies/Evidence.
common_rules.observation_lane_routing: Every P1 metric declares observation_lane and publication_route. P1-AIR-* publishes to AIRCRAFT_CAP_L1_OBSERVATION/CAPABILITY_OBSERVATION; MISSION_SYSTEM_INSTANCE metrics publish to SYSTEM_PERFORMANCE_OBSERVATION; reference/alignment/data-quality metrics that must not become capability/system observations publish to QUALITY_EVIDENCE_ONLY/METRIC_INSTANCE_EVIDENCE_ONLY. QUALITY_EVIDENCE_ONLY metrics MUST have p1_longitudinal_trend_eligibility=false and MUST NOT create longitudinal_sample rows.
common_rules.reference_identity_authority: Identification metrics compare evaluated-system labels only against CONTRACT_REFERENCE_IDENTITY_CLASSIFICATION_V1, normalized by the exact REFERENCE_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY_CONTRACT_V1 instance. No fallback to reported_target_id/classification is permitted.
common_rules.reference_match_eligibility: Mission-system accuracy metrics that bind CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 use only the exact profile_id/version/hash supplied in MetricContext. Eligibility thresholds are configuration data; missing profile fields are an error, not an implicit default.
common_rules.event_authority: Opportunity/confirmation state machines execute only in the WRE canonical event builders. Metrics consume CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 / CONTRACT_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_EVENT_V1 and never rebuild those events.
common_rules.profile_input_exact_name_contract: For every Metric, the set of declared profile_parameters MUST equal exactly the suffix set of input_fields entries named profile.<parameter>. Generic aliases such as profile.band/profile.deadband/profile.event_window are forbidden; API/Profile editors consume exact Catalog parameter names only.
common_rules.passive_scope_contract: P1-PSV-* applies only to canonical mission_system_instance.system_type in {'IRST','EO'}; no external 'approved passive set' is consulted.
common_rules.formula_input_exact_name_contract: Canonical source/event field names referenced by a metric formula must be present with the exact same name in input_fields or be explicitly identified as an intermediate derived inside that formula. Slash/or aliases and effective_or_publish/receive_or_use alternatives are forbidden.
common_rules.shared_event_authority_contract: Canonical Opportunity, Confirmation and Fusion Handover events are built once by WRE. Metric Plugins consume the versioned event contract and never rerun the owning state machine or infer event authority from another Metric result.
common_rules.control_response_channel_contract: Command-response metrics consume CONTRACT_CONTROL_RESPONSE_CHANNEL_MAP_V1; command axis to response channel/polarity mapping is never inferred inside the Metric.
common_rules.metric_value_transport_contract: Catalog value_kind is authoritative. NUMERIC/TEXT/BOOLEAN/STRUCTURED map to typed result slots; STRUCTURED uses value_structured/object and MUST NOT be JSON-serialized into value_text. For VALID results exactly the value slot matching semantic value_kind is populated; non-VALID results may have all value slots null.
common_rules.structured_output_schema_contract: Every STRUCTURED metric binds exactly one structured_output_schema_id in structured_output_schema_registry. The required field set, nullability/enums and nesting are immutable output-schema semantics; changing them requires algorithm version and, when comparability changes, semantic_version.
common_rules.longitudinal_value_contract: P1 longitudinal longitudinal_sample is numeric-only. p1_longitudinal_trend_eligibility=true requires value_kind=NUMERIC and default_aggregation=MEDIAN. STRUCTURED or quality-only metrics use default_aggregation=NONE and never enter longitudinal_sample unless a future separately versioned component metric/projection contract is introduced.
common_rules.default_aggregation_contract: default_aggregation is the baseline SESSION_CONFIG longitudinal aggregation, not a free formula selector. Current values are MEDIAN for trend-eligible NUMERIC metrics and NONE for metrics that do not enter P1 longitudinal. Approved alternate sample profiles are governed separately and segment comparison keys.
common_rules.structured_schema_standard: structured_output_schema_registry[].json_schema is the executable authority and MUST be valid JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 with additionalProperties=false at every object level. field_contracts is a human-readable summary only. DB schema_json seeds exactly json_schema; API returns the same schema/hash.
common_rules.structured_session_time_transport: Any Session Time field embedded in a STRUCTURED value uses decimal-string JSON representation, never JSON integer/float, preserving 64-bit precision across JavaScript/API clients.
common_rules.structured_schema_hash_contract: schema_hash_sha256 = SHA-256 of json_schema serialized as UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys and separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=false. DB seed/API/build manifest use this exact hash; implementations MUST NOT hash field_contracts or pretty-printed JSON.
common_rules.p_capability_boundary: P1 measures observed engineering performance. P2 performs context attribution/normalization. P3 estimates intrinsic capability. P5 evaluates team/mission process.
common_rules.radar_sensor_scope_contract: P1-SNS-* is the RADAR sensor detection/measurement family. It applies only when canonical mission_system_instance.system_type='RADAR'. SNS is not a generic all-sensor family; IRST/EO use P1-PSV-*, RWR/ESM use P1-ESM-*, DATALINK uses P1-DL-* and FUSION uses P1-FUS-* where applicable.
common_rules.rwr_esm_scope_contract: P1-ESM-* applies only when canonical mission_system_instance.system_type is in {'RWR','ESM'}.

metrics.name: REFERENCE_RELATIVE_STATE
metrics.formula: Publish exactly STRUCT_P1_QA_001_V1. Compute r_rel_ecef_m=p_target-p_own and v_rel_ecef_mps=v_target-v_own; range_m=||r_rel|| and range_rate_mps=(r_rel·v_rel)/||r_rel||. Transform r_rel into own-body to publish own_body_az_rad/own_body_el_rad. If sensor_boresight_quat is present and valid, also publish sensor_az_rad/sensor_el_rad and sensor_frame_status=AVAILABLE; otherwise both sensor angles are null and sensor_frame_status=NOT_CONFIGURED. The field set never changes.
metrics.validity_conditions: own/target identity resolved; aligned timestamps; positions finite; frame transform valid; range>0
metrics.na_conditions: target/own truth unavailable or time alignment unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic two-aircraft ECEF trajectories with hand-computable range/az/el/range-rate including wrap and frame rotation.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes the structured reference-relative-state output schema; optional sensor-frame availability changes nullability/status, never the field set.

metrics.name: REFERENCE_TRUTH_UNCERTAINTY
metrics.formula: Publish exactly STRUCT_P1_QA_002_V1. For every uncertainty_ref, consume CONTRACT_NAV_UNCERTAINTY_REPRESENTATION_V1. Convert COVARIANCE directly; convert SIGMA_1D to variance sigma^2; convert TWO_SIDED_HARD_BOUND ±b to variance b^2/3. Build P_inputs, propagate P_rel=J P_inputs J^T, then publish sigma_range_m, sigma_az_rad, sigma_el_rad and sigma_position_3d_m. No Evaluation Profile or manual fallback selects a representation or output field.
metrics.validity_conditions: all required uncertainty refs resolve to valid CONTRACT_NAV_UNCERTAINTY_REPRESENTATION_V1 records for the evaluation interval; units/frames compatible; relative_state_jacobian finite
metrics.na_conditions: a required uncertainty representation/provenance is absent, invalid, unit/frame incompatible, or Jacobian unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Monte-Carlo/analytic covariance propagation fixture with known diagonal covariance and numeric tolerance.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 final closure removes manual/approved-bound fallback and freezes navigation uncertainty representation authority.

metrics.name: MEASUREMENT_ERROR_DECOMPOSITION
metrics.formula: Publish exactly STRUCT_P1_QA_006_V1 with error_domain, residual_unit, raw_residual, reference_uncertainty, alignment_uncertainty, sensor_reported_uncertainty, normalized_residual and normalized_residual_status. raw_residual and uncertainty components are never algebraically subtracted. When sigma_ref, sigma_align and sigma_sensor are all finite and the combined denominator is >0, normalized_residual=raw_residual/sqrt(sigma_ref^2+sigma_align^2+sigma_sensor^2) and status=VALID; otherwise normalized_residual=null and status=INSUFFICIENT_UNCERTAINTY. Missing sensor uncertainty is represented as null, not by removing the field.
metrics.validity_conditions: residual and at least reference/alignment quality available
metrics.na_conditions: reference quality invalid
metrics.golden_test: Fixture where same residual under different truth uncertainty retains equal raw error but different normalized residual.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes the structured output field set; normalized_residual is nullable-by-rule rather than optional-by-implementation.

metrics.name: SENSOR_TIME_OFFSET_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Within each SM_CLOCK_SEGMENT_V1 stable clock segment, offset_us=aligned_session_time_us-sensor_timestamp_mapped_to_session_time_us. Primary Metric value=MEAN_V1(offset_us) arithmetic bias for that segment. RMS_V1(offset_us) RMSE and QUANTILE_HF7_V1(offset_us,0.95) P95 are mandatory diagnostic Evidence fields, not additional Metric values. One segment produces one MetricInstance/Observation with its exact time range; never aggregate samples across a clock-segment boundary before publication.
metrics.validity_conditions: sensor clock segment resolved; transform valid
metrics.na_conditions: sensor has no timestamp or transform unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Clock fixture with fixed +2000 us offset and reset segment; verify per-segment bias and no cross-reset mixing.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 selects one scalar primary value (mean offset/bias); RMSE/P95 remain deterministic evidence. semantic_version increments to prevent mixing with the prior multi-output contract.

metrics.name: SENSOR_TO_INS_LATENCY_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: latency_us=sensor_measurement_effective_time_us-referenced_ownship_state_effective_time_us. Primary Metric value=MEDIAN_V1(latency_us) over eligible samples; QUANTILE_HF7_V1 P95 latency is mandatory diagnostic Evidence. Never infer latency when timestamps have unresolved time bases.
metrics.validity_conditions: both effective times resolved to Session Time
metrics.na_conditions: one or both effective times unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Fixture with known 40 ms producer delay and irregular samples; verify median/P95.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 selects median latency as the scalar primary value; P95 is diagnostic evidence. semantic_version increments from the prior ambiguous median/P95 output.

metrics.name: INTERPOLATION_AGE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: For every measurement, age_us=max(measurement_time_us-left_truth_time_us, right_truth_time_us-measurement_time_us). Samples with age_us>max_gap_us are ineligible. Primary Metric value=MEDIAN_V1(age_us); QUANTILE_HF7_V1(age_us,0.95) and max(age_us) are mandatory diagnostic Evidence. max_gap_us is the only metric-profile eligibility parameter.
metrics.validity_conditions: bracketing truth points exist and gap <= profile max_gap
metrics.na_conditions: no valid bracketing points
metrics.golden_test: Irregular truth samples with known bracketing ages and an over-gap case that must become N/A.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 selects median interpolation age as scalar primary value; P95/max remain evidence. semantic_version increments from the prior multi-output contract.

metrics.name: OWNSHIP_INS_TIME_UNCERTAINTY
metrics.formula: Resolve ownship_nav_time_uncertainty_ref under CONTRACT_NAV_UNCERTAINTY_REPRESENTATION_V1. Use SIGMA_1D directly or convert TWO_SIDED_HARD_BOUND ±b to sigma=b/sqrt(3); COVARIANCE is permitted only as a 1x1 time-variance record. Combine independent source-clock and TimeTransform residual uncertainty as sigma_time_us=sqrt(sigma_source_us^2+sigma_transform_us^2).
metrics.validity_conditions: ownship time uncertainty ref and TimeTransform residual sigma resolve for the same interval with compatible units
metrics.na_conditions: ownship uncertainty representation/provenance or TimeTransform residual uncertainty unavailable/invalid
metrics.evidence: ownship INS clock metadata + TimeTransform residuals
metrics.golden_test: Known ±500 us bound and transform residual fixture.
metrics.notes: Ownship INS time uncertainty is Reference/Time Quality evidence. It MUST NOT publish to Aircraft CAP-L1 or create P1 longitudinal longitudinal samples; downstream mission-system observations retain it as evidence/context.

metrics.name: TARGET_INS_TIME_UNCERTAINTY
metrics.formula: Resolve target_nav_time_uncertainty_ref under CONTRACT_NAV_UNCERTAINTY_REPRESENTATION_V1. Use SIGMA_1D directly or convert TWO_SIDED_HARD_BOUND ±b to sigma=b/sqrt(3); COVARIANCE is permitted only as a 1x1 time-variance record. Combine independent source-clock and TimeTransform residual uncertainty as sigma_time_us=sqrt(sigma_source_us^2+sigma_transform_us^2).
metrics.validity_conditions: target time uncertainty ref and TimeTransform residual sigma resolve for the same interval with compatible units
metrics.na_conditions: target uncertainty representation/provenance or TimeTransform residual uncertainty unavailable/invalid
metrics.evidence: target INS clock metadata + TimeTransform residuals
metrics.golden_test: Known ±800 us bound and transform residual fixture.
metrics.notes: TARGET_PAIR target-clock uncertainty does not create a P1 longitudinal longitudinal subject; it follows the owning mission-system observation/sample as quality evidence.

metrics.name: MAX_ABS_BODY_ROLL_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: max(abs(body_p_rad_s)) over validity-piece samples in the eligible window. The window is eligible only when valid covered duration/window duration >= min_coverage and no internal gap exceeds max_gap_us.
metrics.validity_conditions: body_p valid; eligible-window coverage >= min_coverage; no internal gap > max_gap_us; unit/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: body angular-rate channel unavailable; coverage < min_coverage; or gap > max_gap_us
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic constant/peak p series including high-pitch case; must not substitute Euler roll derivative.

metrics.name: MAX_NZ_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Primary Metric value = max(valid nz_g) over the eligible window. Diagnostic Evidence records min(valid nz_g); that diagnostic value is not part of the Metric value/output schema.
metrics.validity_conditions: Nz calibrated and valid
metrics.na_conditions: Nz channel unavailable/invalid
metrics.evidence: canonical Nz rows + quality + eligible window + diagnostic min_nz_g
metrics.golden_test: Fixture with known peaks, gaps and invalid samples; invalid peak excluded.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes the implementation-selectable optional companion output; P1-AIR-002 has one authoritative Metric value: maximum valid Nz.

metrics.name: TRUE_HEADING_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Unwrap heading_true_rad, then compute angular rate with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1: local first-order least-squares slope over the declared derivative_window_s using only same-validity-piece samples and never bridging max_gap_us. Metric value is abs(rate).
metrics.validity_conditions: true heading valid; gap control; unwrap valid
metrics.na_conditions: heading unavailable or eligible duration too short
metrics.golden_test: 359°→1° wrap fixture and constant-rate turn; verify no 358° spike.

metrics.name: SUSTAINED_TRUE_HEADING_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Use the P1-AIR-003 instantaneous absolute heading-rate series. Inside SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1 compute ROLLING_MEDIAN_V1 over sustain_duration_s; a window is eligible only when min_coverage is met and no internal gap exceeds max_gap_us. Primary Metric value=maximum eligible rolling-median heading rate; the exact supporting dwell interval is mandatory Evidence, not an additional result value.
metrics.applicable_window: turn windows with minimum sustained duration
metrics.validity_conditions: P1-AIR-003 valid; enough continuous duration
metrics.na_conditions: insufficient continuous duration
metrics.golden_test: Constant-rate turn plus short spike; sustained result must reject transient spike.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 adds explicit max-gap/validity-piece closure for sustained heading rate.

metrics.name: HORIZONTAL_TURN_RADIUS_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Compute horizontal speed V_horizontal and unwrap track_true_rad. Compute track-rate omega with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 using derivative_window_s without bridging max_gap_us. For samples with abs(omega)>=min_turn_rate_rad_s, R=V_horizontal/abs(omega). Primary Metric value=MEDIAN_V1(R) over the eligible turn interval; min(R) is mandatory diagnostic Evidence, not an additional Metric value.
metrics.validity_conditions: ground speed and track valid; |track_rate|>epsilon
metrics.na_conditions: track/ground speed absent or no valid turn interval
metrics.golden_test: Circular horizontal trajectory with known radius; verify recovered radius within tolerance.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 selects median observed turn radius as scalar primary value; minimum radius is evidence. semantic_version increments from the prior dual-output contract.

metrics.name: SUSTAINED_NZ_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Within each SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1 interval compute ROLLING_MEDIAN_V1(nz_g) over sustain_duration_s. A rolling window is eligible only when min_coverage is met and no internal gap exceeds max_gap_us. Primary Metric value=maximum eligible rolling-median Nz; the exact supporting dwell interval is mandatory Evidence.
metrics.validity_conditions: Nz valid and continuous for sustain duration
metrics.na_conditions: insufficient valid dwell
metrics.golden_test: Short spike vs sustained plateau fixture; plateau selected.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes sustain duration/coverage/gap and the rolling operator.

metrics.name: TAS_MACH_ENVELOPE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Publish exactly STRUCT_P1_AIR_007_V1 with fixed tas and mach subrecords. For each channel independently after validity filtering: N>=1 publishes status=VALID, n=N, min/max and QUANTILE_HF7_V1 P05/P50/P95; N=0 publishes status=INSUFFICIENT_DATA, n=0 and all numeric fields null. The Metric is N_A only when both subrecords are INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Altitude/context tags remain Observation/Evidence context and are not additional result fields.
metrics.validity_conditions: at least one finite validity-filtered TAS or Mach sample in the eligible flight window; units/context known
metrics.na_conditions: both TAS and Mach have zero finite validity-filtered samples in the eligible window
metrics.golden_test: Known sequence with invalid extreme; verify invalid sample excluded and quantiles stable.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes undefined “sufficient coverage”; no hidden coverage threshold exists for this envelope statistic.

metrics.name: MAX_ACCELERATION_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Compute a_TAS = d(TAS)/dt with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 over derivative_window_s without bridging max_gap_us; publish the maximum eligible a_TAS.
metrics.validity_conditions: DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 returns at least one finite a_TAS estimate from >=3 distinct timestamps inside one validity piece under derivative_window_s/max_gap_us
metrics.na_conditions: TAS unavailable or DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 returns no finite eligible estimate
metrics.golden_test: Linear TAS ramp with injected noise/gap; recover slope within tolerance.

metrics.name: SUSTAINED_ACCELERATION_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Compute a_TAS=d(TAS)/dt with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 using derivative_window_s/max_gap_us inside SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1. Apply ROLLING_MEDIAN_V1 over sustain_duration_s and require min_coverage. Primary Metric value=maximum eligible rolling-median acceleration; the supporting dwell interval is mandatory Evidence.
metrics.validity_conditions: P1-AIR-008 derivative valid and sustain duration met
metrics.na_conditions: no sustained valid interval
metrics.golden_test: Transient spike plus steady acceleration fixture; steady interval must dominate.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 binds derivative and sustained-window operators explicitly.

metrics.name: ACCELERATION_TIME_BAND_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Within one SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1, elapsed time runs from the first valid upward crossing of lower_speed_bound_mps to the first subsequent valid upward crossing of upper_speed_bound_mps. A validity-piece boundary or gap > max_gap_us invalidates the candidate; crossings may not span a reset/discontinuity. Bounds are Evaluation Profile data.
metrics.validity_conditions: both declared speed-bound crossings occur in order inside the same SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1 and no gap between supporting samples exceeds max_gap_us
metrics.na_conditions: lower or upper configured bound is not crossed in order inside one validity piece; any supporting gap exceeds max_gap_us; or speed data are invalid
metrics.evidence: TAS/Mach series + band profile + crossing evidence
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic monotonic ramp crossing configured band; verify exact crossing interpolation and N/A when upper not reached.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 replaces ambiguous reset handling with validity-piece semantics. ED-1.5.12 removes undefined adequate-coverage wording; crossing/gap eligibility is exact. ED-1.5.12 freezes exact profile.<parameter> input-field names; generic profile aliases are forbidden.

metrics.name: MAX_DECELERATION_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Compute a_TAS=d(TAS)/dt with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 using derivative_window_s/max_gap_us inside SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1. Over eligible samples with a_TAS<0, publish abs(min(a_TAS)).
metrics.validity_conditions: TAS derivative valid
metrics.na_conditions: no valid deceleration interval
metrics.golden_test: Linear deceleration ramp; verify magnitude and gap rejection.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes the deceleration derivative estimator/gap policy.

metrics.name: DECELERATION_TIME_BAND_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Within one SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1, elapsed time runs from the first valid downward crossing of upper_speed_bound_mps to the first subsequent valid downward crossing of lower_speed_bound_mps. A gap > max_gap_us or validity-piece boundary invalidates the candidate. Publish elapsed seconds; lower_speed_bound_mps must be < upper_speed_bound_mps.
metrics.validity_conditions: both declared downward band crossings occur in order inside one validity piece with every supporting gap <=max_gap_us
metrics.na_conditions: lower/upper bound not crossed in order inside one validity piece; a supporting gap exceeds max_gap_us; or speed is invalid
metrics.golden_test: Known ramp from upper to lower threshold; verify duration.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes deceleration-band crossing/gap semantics. ED-1.5.12 freezes exact profile.<parameter> input-field names; generic profile aliases are forbidden.

metrics.name: MAX_CLIMB_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Compute climb_rate_mps=d(alt_msl_m)/dt with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 using derivative_window_s/max_gap_us inside SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1. Publish max(climb_rate_mps) over eligible positive-climb samples. When a canonical vertical_speed channel exists, diagnostic Evidence records it as a cross-check; it is never substituted into the Metric value.
metrics.validity_conditions: altitude MSL valid; derivative/gap profile valid
metrics.na_conditions: altitude unavailable or no positive climb interval
metrics.golden_test: Linear altitude ramp and optional consistent vertical-speed channel; verify rate.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes undefined smoothing and freezes climb-rate derivation. ED-1.5.12 removes implementation-selectable diagnostic wording; vertical-speed cross-check provenance is deterministic when the source channel exists.

metrics.name: SUSTAINED_CLIMB_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Compute climb_rate_mps=d(alt_msl_m)/dt with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 using derivative_window_s/max_gap_us. Within SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1 apply ROLLING_MEDIAN_V1 over sustain_duration_s and require min_coverage. Primary Metric value=maximum eligible rolling-median climb rate; the supporting dwell interval is mandatory Evidence.
metrics.validity_conditions: continuous climb duration met
metrics.na_conditions: no sustained climb interval
metrics.golden_test: Short climb spike + steady climb; steady selected.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes derivative and sustained-climb operators/parameters.

metrics.name: DIVE_ACCELERATION_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Compute dTAS/dt and dh/dt with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 using derivative_window_s and max_gap_us. A sample is dive-eligible only when dh/dt <= -min_descent_rate_mps. The metric value is the fixed P95 of eligible dTAS/dt samples in the dive window; also retain altitude-loss context in Evidence. No Profile parameter may select a different summary statistic.
metrics.validity_conditions: TAS/altitude valid; descent condition met
metrics.na_conditions: no valid dive interval
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic descending accelerating segment and level acceleration; only dive segment eligible.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.2 freezes the dive-acceleration summary as P95; previous 1.0.0 text left the summary unspecified.

metrics.name: SUSTAINED_ROLL_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Within SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1 compute ROLLING_MEDIAN_V1(abs(body_roll_rate_p_rad_s)) over sustain_duration_s. Require min_coverage and no gap>max_gap_us. Primary Metric value=maximum eligible rolling-median roll rate; the supporting dwell interval is mandatory Evidence.
metrics.validity_conditions: p valid and sustain duration met
metrics.na_conditions: no sustained roll interval
metrics.golden_test: Transient roll spike vs plateau fixture.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes sustained-roll duration/coverage/gap.

metrics.name: ROLL_TO_BANK_TIME_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Starting at supplied roll_onset_time_us inside SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1, find the first time abs(roll_rad-roll_at_onset)>=bank_delta_rad and the attained side remains within bank_tolerance_rad for achievement_persistence_s. Any gap > max_gap_us before achievement invalidates the event. Publish elapsed time; roll onset is supplied and is never rediscovered inside this metric.
metrics.validity_conditions: roll attitude valid; onset/target persistence resolved
metrics.na_conditions: configured bank change not reached or ambiguous onset
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic 0→60° transition with overshoot; verify first stable crossing, not first noisy crossing.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes max-gap handling in bank-achievement timing.

metrics.name: NOSE_POINTING_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Transform aircraft body +X boresight by attitude_quat into the declared inertial/local frame. For each consecutive valid sample pair with 0<dt_us<=max_gap_us, GEODESIC_PAIR_RATE_V1 computes omega_i. Primary Metric value=QUANTILE_HF7_V1(omega_i,0.95) over finite eligible pair rates. The pair-rate series is retained as Evidence and is not itself stored in the scalar Metric value.
metrics.validity_conditions: at least one finite GEODESIC_PAIR_RATE_V1 pair rate exists under max_gap_us; attitude/frame convention resolved
metrics.na_conditions: attitude/frame unavailable or no finite eligible pair rate
metrics.evidence: attitude series + frame definition + derivative profile
metrics.golden_test: Quaternion fixture with known constant yaw/pitch slew; verify angular-rate magnitude.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 changes the result meaning from an unstorable rate series to a scalar P95 observed nose-pointing rate; semantic_version and algorithm major version increment.

metrics.name: AOA_ENVELOPE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Publish exactly STRUCT_P1_AIR_025_V1 over the eligible window: sample_count=N plus min_rad, max_rad and QUANTILE_HF7_V1 P05/P50/P95 as p05_rad/p50_rad/p95_rad. Require N>=1 finite AoA sample. P1 does not interpret these observed statistics as a stall boundary; any later stall-limit claim requires a separate versioned reference contract.
metrics.validity_conditions: at least one finite AoA sample exists in the eligible window; AoA unit/frame convention resolved
metrics.na_conditions: no finite AoA sample in the eligible window or AoA convention unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Known AoA series with invalid outlier; quantiles exclude invalid sample.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 formalizes AOA_ENVELOPE as a fixed structured result; semantic_version increments because the previous scalar storage contract could not represent the declared envelope.

metrics.name: HIGH_AOA_DWELL_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Inside SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1, form high-AoA episodes where aoa_rad>=aoa_threshold_rad continuously for at least min_dwell_s without a gap > max_gap_us. dwell_ratio=sum(qualified high-AoA episode duration)/eligible_time. aoa_threshold_rad is Evaluation Profile data, not a stall/capability limit.
metrics.validity_conditions: AoA finite; profile.aoa_threshold_rad/profile.min_dwell_s/profile.max_gap_us resolved; eligible time >0
metrics.na_conditions: AoA unavailable; profile parameters unresolved; or no eligible time
metrics.golden_test: Piecewise AoA fixture with known dwell fraction.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes high-AoA dwell/gap qualification. ED-1.5.12 freezes exact profile.<parameter> input-field names; generic profile aliases are forbidden.

metrics.name: SPECIFIC_MECHANICAL_ENERGY_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: E_s = G0_MPS2*alt_msl_m + 0.5*TAS^2 using the exact constant-registry value; preserve altitude datum metadata and never mix altitude datums inside one result.
metrics.validity_conditions: TAS and MSL altitude valid; no mixed altitude datum
metrics.na_conditions: TAS or MSL altitude unavailable
metrics.golden_test: Hand-computable TAS/altitude points; exact energy within tolerance.

metrics.name: SPECIFIC_ENERGY_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Compute E_s from P1-AIR-016 at every eligible sample, then compute dE_s/dt with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 over derivative_window_s within the same validity piece and never bridge max_gap_us. The derivative estimator/filter family is fixed by this Algorithm Contract; Profile controls only derivative_window_s and max_gap_us.
metrics.validity_conditions: P1-AIR-016 provides finite energy samples and DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 returns at least one finite dE_s/dt estimate under derivative_window_s/max_gap_us
metrics.na_conditions: P1-AIR-016 unavailable or no finite derivative estimate is produced
metrics.golden_test: Analytic climb/acceleration fixture with known dE/dt.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.2 replaces the undefined approved smoothing/gap policy with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1.

metrics.name: SPECIFIC_EXCESS_POWER_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Inside SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1 compute dh/dt and d(TAS)/dt with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 using the same derivative_window_s/max_gap_us. Then P_s_obs = dh/dt + (TAS/G0_MPS2)*d(TAS)/dt. This is observed kinematic specific excess power, not a thrust-drag model.
metrics.validity_conditions: TAS/altitude derivatives valid
metrics.na_conditions: TAS or altitude derivative invalid
metrics.golden_test: Analytic constant climb and acceleration fixture; compare closed-form Ps.
metrics.notes: Observed result must not be labeled intrinsic/theoretical Ps. ED-1.5.12 freezes derivative provenance and G0 constant binding.

metrics.name: ENERGY_RETENTION_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Publish exactly STRUCT_P1_AIR_019_V1. Using P1-AIR-016 at exact maneuver-window endpoints, retention_ratio=E_s_end/E_s_start only when abs(E_s_start)>ENERGY_DENOM_EPS_J_PER_KG and delta_E_s_j_per_kg=E_s_end-E_s_start. median_energy_rate_w_per_kg=MEDIAN_V1 of finite valid P1-AIR-017 samples strictly inside the same window; if none exist, set that field null and median_energy_rate_status=INSUFFICIENT_RATE_SAMPLES while endpoint fields remain valid. Do not clamp an ineligible denominator.
metrics.validity_conditions: finite P1-AIR-016 values available at both exact maneuver-window endpoints and abs(E_s_start)>ENERGY_DENOM_EPS_J_PER_KG
metrics.na_conditions: start/end energy unavailable or denominator guard fails; absence of interior P1-AIR-017 samples nulls only median_energy_rate and does not invalidate retention_ratio/delta_E_s
metrics.golden_test: Known 100→90 energy window gives 0.9 retention with matching delta.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 replaces undefined “sufficient window coverage” with exact endpoint and interior-sample rules.

metrics.name: ENERGY_RECOVERY_TIME_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Let loss=pre_event_reference_energy-post_event_min_energy and recovery_target=post_event_min_energy+recovery_fraction*loss. From maneuver_end_time_us, search no longer than max_recovery_window_s inside SM_POST_MANEUVER_RECOVERY_WINDOW_V1 without bridging any gap > max_gap_us. Publish elapsed time to the first crossing E_s>=recovery_target that remains continuously above target for min_crossing_persistence_s. If loss<=0, the window terminates, or no persistent crossing occurs, return the specified N_A/INSUFFICIENT_DATA status.
metrics.validity_conditions: pre-event reference and post-event continuous energy available
metrics.na_conditions: criterion not reached before window end or data insufficient
metrics.evidence: event marker + energy series + recovery profile
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic energy drop then recovery; verify crossing time and N/A if not recovered.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes recovery horizon and crossing persistence.

metrics.name: ENERGY_RECOVERY_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Within the supplied post-maneuver recovery interval qualified by SM_POST_MANEUVER_RECOVERY_WINDOW_V1 and SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1, never bridge a gap > max_gap_us. Select finite P1-AIR-017 samples with dE_s/dt>0 and publish MEDIAN_V1 of those strictly positive rates. If the recovery interval is resolved but contains no strictly positive finite P1-AIR-017 sample, return INSUFFICIENT_DATA; if the recovery interval itself is unresolved, return N_A. Profile cannot select another statistic.
metrics.validity_conditions: qualified recovery interval resolved; at least one finite P1-AIR-017 sample exists inside the interval; no supporting gap exceeds max_gap_us
metrics.na_conditions: N_A when the recovery interval is unresolved; INSUFFICIENT_DATA when the resolved interval contains no strictly positive finite P1-AIR-017 sample
metrics.golden_test: Constant recovery slope fixture.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.2 freezes recovery rate to the median of strictly positive valid dE_s/dt samples. ED-1.5.12 binds recovery-window qualification and upstream energy-rate producer.

metrics.name: CLIMB_ENERGY_PARTITION_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Use P1-AIR-017 dE_s/dt computed with the same derivative_window_s/max_gap_us and compute dh/dt with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 inside the same SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1. When dE_s/dt>ENERGY_RATE_EPS_W_PER_KG and dh/dt>0, primary Metric value eta_climb_obs=(G0_MPS2*dh/dt)/(dE_s/dt). Values outside [0,1] are not clamped; instead emit OUTSIDE_[0,1] as deterministic Evidence/reason flag. This is observed energy partition, not propulsion efficiency.
metrics.validity_conditions: TAS/altitude derivatives valid; total energy rate positive
metrics.na_conditions: energy rate non-positive/near-zero or no climb
metrics.golden_test: Analytic climb+acceleration fixture with known potential/total energy-rate ratio.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes epsilon, derivative provenance and bounds/flag behavior.

metrics.name: DIVE_ENERGY_GAIN_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Publish exactly STRUCT_P1_AIR_039_V1. Consume exactly the dive-eligible intervals produced by P1-AIR-015, ordered by start_session_time_us. For each interval publish start_session_time_us/end_session_time_us as decimal-string Session Time values, delta_E_s_j_per_kg from P1-AIR-016 and MEDIAN_V1 of valid P1-AIR-017 dE_s/dt samples; when no interior rate sample exists, median_energy_rate_w_per_kg=null and median_energy_rate_status=INSUFFICIENT_RATE_SAMPLES. interval_count equals the array length. Altitude loss and TAS gain remain Evidence, not extra result fields.
metrics.validity_conditions: energy valid; descent condition met
metrics.na_conditions: no valid dive interval
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic descent with known energy change and speed gain.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 binds dive qualification and energy-series producers explicitly.

metrics.name: CONTROL_RESPONSE_DELAY_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Within SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1, command onset is the first sample crossing command_deadband in the commanded sign and remaining beyond it for command_persistence_s. Response onset is the first same-sign response crossing response_threshold and remaining beyond it for response_persistence_s within max_search_s. Any gap > max_gap_us invalidates the candidate event. delay=t_response_onset-t_command_onset. The SM_COMMAND_RESPONSE_EVENT_V1 state machine is fixed; Profile supplies only these numeric thresholds/durations.
metrics.validity_conditions: calibrated control command and corresponding response available; calibration id/version/hash valid for event interval; mode value constant during candidate event; Session-Time alignment valid; control-response map id/version/hash resolves the command axis to one canonical response channel/polarity for the event interval
metrics.na_conditions: control input absent, mode ambiguous, response not found, or overlapping command prevents attribution
metrics.evidence: command rows + response rows + onset markers + profile
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic step command with known response delay, noise, false early blip and missing-response case.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 makes max-gap invalidation explicit. ED-1.5.12 freezes exact profile.<parameter> input-field names; generic profile aliases are forbidden.

metrics.name: CONTROL_RESPONSE_GAIN_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Publish exactly STRUCT_P1_AIR_035_V1. For each SM_COMMAND_RESPONSE_EVENT_V1 isolated event, restrict samples to event_window_s, exclude command magnitudes <=command_deadband, reject sequences containing a gap >max_gap_us, and for one fixed axis/mode compute THEIL_SEN_GAIN_V1 of delta_response versus delta_command with at least min_unique_command_levels. Group events by (control_axis,mode,response_channel,response_unit,gain_unit); within each group event_gains are ordered by event start Session Time and contain exactly event_id+gain. Axes/modes/channels are never mixed.
metrics.validity_conditions: calibrated command and response available; calibration id/version/hash valid for every event; mode value constant within event; at least min_unique_command_levels distinct eligible command levels after deadband/gap filtering; control-response map id/version/hash resolves the command axis to one canonical response channel/polarity for the event interval
metrics.na_conditions: control calibration/response unavailable; fewer than min_unique_command_levels distinct eligible command levels; or event attribution ambiguous
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic step/ramp inputs with known linear gain and saturation case.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 closes event-window/deadband/gap parameter use. ED-1.5.12 freezes exact profile.<parameter> input-field names; generic profile aliases are forbidden.

metrics.name: CONTROL_DEADBAND_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Across SM_COMMAND_RESPONSE_EVENT_V1 excitation events, a candidate calibrated command change must persist for command_persistence_s, remain inside one validity piece with no gap > max_gap_us, and its associated response must exceed response_threshold under the P1-AIR-027 response-onset state machine. Require at least min_event_count qualified events; publish the smallest persistent absolute calibrated command change. This is an observed relation, not a hard control-law limit.
metrics.validity_conditions: control calibration valid; mode value constant per event; at least min_event_count qualified excitation/response events satisfy response_threshold and command_persistence_s; control-response map id/version/hash resolves the command axis to one canonical response channel/polarity for the event interval
metrics.na_conditions: control calibration unavailable; fewer than min_event_count qualified events; mode changes within event; or response threshold cannot be resolved
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic deadband nonlinearity with known deadband and noise.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 closes persistence/count/gap eligibility.

metrics.name: RESPONSE_PERSISTENCE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: For each qualified P1-AIR-027 response onset, measure duration until response falls below signed response_threshold, a disqualifying reversal exceeds reversal_threshold, or max_gap_us is exceeded. Require at least min_event_count qualified events. Primary Metric value=MEDIAN_V1(completed response duration); QUANTILE_HF7_V1 P95 duration and completion_ratio=completed_events/qualified_events are mandatory diagnostic Evidence.
metrics.validity_conditions: response onset valid; sign/mode resolved; control-response map id/version/hash resolves the command axis to one canonical response channel/polarity for the event interval
metrics.na_conditions: no valid onset or overlapping commands
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic response with transient blip vs sustained response.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 selects median completed response duration as scalar primary value; P95/completion ratio are evidence. semantic_version increments from the prior mixed-unit multi-output contract.

metrics.name: CONTROL_INPUT_RATE_RMS
metrics.formula: After excluding control samples with abs(command)<=control_deadband, compute control-input rate with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 using derivative_window_s and never bridging max_gap_us/SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1 boundaries. Publish RMS_V1(rate) over the eligible window.
metrics.validity_conditions: calibrated control command valid with calibration id/version/hash covering the evaluated interval
metrics.na_conditions: control channel unavailable
metrics.golden_test: Sinusoidal control input with analytic derivative RMS.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 makes derivative window/gap explicit.

metrics.name: CONTROL_REVERSAL_COUNT
metrics.formula: Using the calibrated canonical control command supplied under CONTRACT_CONTROL_INPUT_CALIBRATION_V1, count a reversal when sign changes across ±control_deadband and the new sign persists for reversal_persistence_s without a gap > max_gap_us. One persistent sign change counts once; the Metric Plugin performs no de-bias/re-calibration.
metrics.validity_conditions: calibrated control command valid; calibration id/version/hash covers the evaluated interval; profile parameters resolved
metrics.na_conditions: control unavailable
metrics.golden_test: Fixture with noise around zero and 3 true reversals; expect 3.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes exact profile.<parameter> input-field names; generic profile aliases are forbidden.

metrics.name: ATTITUDE_OSCILLATION_INDEX
metrics.formula: Publish exactly STRUCT_P1_AIR_030_V1 with roll and pitch subrecords. For each attitude axis independently, each SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1 interval with duration>=min_window_s and valid coverage>=min_coverage is filtered by BANDPASS_BUTTERWORTH4_ZP_V1 using low_hz/high_hz/resample_rate_hz/filter_padding_s; any source gap >max_gap_us splits the piece. If an axis has at least one eligible filtered piece, publish status=VALID and RMS_V1 over all eligible filtered samples for that axis; otherwise publish status=INSUFFICIENT_DATA and rms_rad=null. Overall Metric is N_A only when both axes are insufficient.
metrics.validity_conditions: at least one of roll/pitch has an eligible interval with duration>=min_window_s, coverage>=min_coverage, 0<low_hz<high_hz<resample_rate_hz/2 and deterministic filter grid/padding requirements satisfied
metrics.na_conditions: both roll and pitch lack any eligible deterministic filter interval
metrics.evidence: attitude rows + filter profile + spectral/energy evidence
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic sine oscillation plus drift; verify band component and drift rejection.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes resampling rate, Butterworth design, reflection padding, zero-phase execution, coverage and gap semantics; library defaults are forbidden.

metrics.name: JERK_RMS
metrics.formula: Inside each SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1, apply DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 independently to calibrated body-frame ax, ay, az using derivative_window_s/max_gap_us. For timestamps where all three derivative components are finite, compute jerk_norm_mps3=sqrt(jx^2+jy^2+jz^2) and publish RMS_V1(jerk_norm_mps3). No nz or single-axis fallback is permitted.
metrics.validity_conditions: all three calibrated body acceleration components are finite in at least one eligible derivative window and DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 returns a simultaneous finite jx/jy/jz sample under derivative_window_s/max_gap_us
metrics.na_conditions: three-axis calibrated body acceleration unavailable/invalid or no simultaneous finite 3D jerk sample
metrics.golden_test: Three-axis linear/quadratic body-acceleration fixture with analytically known jerk vector magnitude; verify semantic v2 and forbid nz/single-axis fallback.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 final closure changes JERK_RMS to semantic v2: 3D body acceleration-vector jerk-magnitude RMS. Semantic v1 axis-dependent outputs are not silently comparable; any historical bridge requires explicit TrendBridge approval.

metrics.name: FUEL_FLOW_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Primary Metric value=MEDIAN_V1 of eligible fuel-flow samples within the declared engine/mode/context cohort. QUANTILE_HF7_V1 P95 fuel flow is mandatory diagnostic Evidence. Never mix engine/mode/context cohorts inside one MetricInstance.
metrics.validity_conditions: fuel-flow channel valid
metrics.na_conditions: fuel-flow unavailable
metrics.golden_test: Known constant/step flow fixture.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 selects median fuel flow as scalar primary value; P95 remains evidence. semantic_version increments from the prior median/P95 dual-output contract.

metrics.name: FUEL_BURN_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Split fuel_remaining_kg into derivative pieces with SM_FUEL_QUANTITY_EVENT_V1; when no explicit marker exists, a positive jump >=refuel_jump_threshold_kg starts a reset/refuel event. Exclude event_guard_s around reset/refuel boundaries. Within each remaining SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1 piece compute burn_rate=-d(fuel_remaining_kg)/dt with DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1 using derivative_window_s/max_gap_us; only finite burn_rate>=0 is eligible. fuel_flow_kg_s, when available, is diagnostic cross-check evidence only.
metrics.validity_conditions: fuel remaining valid and monotonic except identified events
metrics.na_conditions: fuel quantity unavailable or refuel/reset unresolved
metrics.evidence: fuel quantity + event markers + optional fuel-flow
metrics.golden_test: Linear fuel decline plus refuel jump; exclude refuel segment.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes reset/refuel detection, derivative and guard semantics.

metrics.name: ENDURANCE_PROXY_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Compute smoothed_burn_rate_kg_s as ROLLING_MEDIAN_V1 of positive valid P1-AIR-033 burn-rate samples over burn_rate_window_s with min_coverage/max_gap_us. If smoothed_burn_rate_kg_s<=FUEL_BURN_RATE_EPS_KG_S return N_A/INSUFFICIENT_DATA; otherwise endurance_proxy_s=fuel_remaining_kg/smoothed_burn_rate_kg_s. This is an observational endurance proxy, not a mission/range prediction.
metrics.validity_conditions: fuel_remaining finite and ROLLING_MEDIAN_V1 returns burn rate >FUEL_BURN_RATE_EPS_KG_S under burn_rate_window_s/min_coverage/max_gap_us
metrics.na_conditions: fuel unavailable; rolling burn-rate window ineligible; or smoothed burn rate <=FUEL_BURN_RATE_EPS_KG_S
metrics.golden_test: Known fuel/flow pair; verify quotient and N/A at zero flow.
metrics.notes: Must not be presented as operational combat radius/range. ED-1.5.12 freezes burn-rate producer, smoothing operator and denominator guard.

metrics.name: DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_COVERAGE
metrics.formula: coverage=total duration of canonical CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 intervals / total authoritative reference-target-present duration for the same evaluated system/reference entity. Opportunity construction is performed upstream by WRE using the frozen opportunity profile; this Metric never rebuilds mode/geometry/reference-quality eligibility and never uses observed detection outcome.
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical opportunity intervals and authoritative reference-target-present intervals resolved for the same evaluated system/reference entity; opportunity profile id/version/hash present
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity contract/profile unavailable or no authoritative reference-target-present duration
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic target-present interval with planned sensor-off segment; verify denominator/eligible coverage.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 makes WRE Opportunity Builder the sole opportunity authority; this Metric is only a coverage view.

metrics.name: DETECTION_RATE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: detection_rate = count of canonical opportunity intervals having at least one CONTRACT_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_EVENT_V1 for the same opportunity_id/reference association / count of canonical CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 intervals. Confirmation persistence and opportunity eligibility are upstream contract semantics; this Metric does not rerun either state machine.
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical opportunity intervals and confirmation events resolved with matching opportunity_id/reference association and profile provenance
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity contract/profile unavailable or no valid opportunities; confirmation contract unresolved when a detection event is claimed
metrics.golden_test: Known 10 opportunities with 8 detections, including one invalid opportunity excluded.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes Metric-local opportunity/confirmation reconstruction.

metrics.name: TIME_TO_FIRST_DETECTION
metrics.formula: time_to_first_detection_s=(first_confirmed_detection_time_us-opportunity_start_time_us)/1e6 using a CONTRACT_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_EVENT_V1 event inside the same CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 interval and authoritative reference association
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical opportunity interval and confirmed-detection event resolved for the same authoritative reference association; Session-Time aligned
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity/confirmation contract unavailable or no confirmed detection inside a valid opportunity
metrics.evidence: opportunity event + first detection row + association
metrics.golden_test: Fixture with opportunity at t0 and detection at t0+3.2s; missing detection => N/A/status.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 consumes canonical opportunity/confirmation events and does not rerun hidden detection-confirmation thresholds.

metrics.name: FIRST_DETECTION_RANGE_OBSERVED
metrics.formula: Interpolate authoritative reference range with LINEAR_INTERPOLATION_V1 at first_confirmed_detection_time_us from CONTRACT_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_EVENT_V1 for the same reference association; never rediscover or re-confirm detection inside this Metric.
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical confirmation event, authoritative reference association and reference relative state are resolved; interpolation gap valid
metrics.na_conditions: confirmation event unavailable or no valid reference range match at the event time
metrics.golden_test: Linear range closure fixture; verify interpolated range.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 consumes the canonical confirmation event directly rather than another Metric result.

metrics.name: RANGE_ERROR_BIAS
metrics.formula: MEAN_V1 of (measured_range-reference_range) over eligible matched samples.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=RANGE; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Constant +50 m bias fixture.

metrics.name: RANGE_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean((measured_range-reference_range)^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=RANGE; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known residual vector [3,4] m -> RMSE sqrt(12.5).

metrics.name: RANGE_ERROR_P95
metrics.formula: quantile(abs(measured_range-reference_range),0.95)
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=RANGE; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Deterministic residual set with hand-computable nearest-rank/interpolation profile.

metrics.name: AZIMUTH_ERROR_BIAS
metrics.formula: circular_mean(wrap_pi(measured_az-reference_az))
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=AZIMUTH; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: 179°/-179° wrap fixture.

metrics.name: AZIMUTH_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(wrap_pi(measured_az-reference_az)^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=AZIMUTH; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known wrapped angular residuals.

metrics.name: ELEVATION_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean((measured_el-reference_el)^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=ELEVATION; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known elevation residuals.

metrics.name: POSITION_3D_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(||p_meas-p_ref||^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=POSITION_3D; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Orthogonal 3D residual fixture.

metrics.name: RADIAL_VELOCITY_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean((vr_meas-vr_ref)^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=RADIAL_VELOCITY; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known closing-rate residuals.

metrics.name: CROSS_RANGE_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(e_cross^2)) after decomposing position error perpendicular to reference LOS
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=CROSS_RANGE; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known radial/cross-range decomposition fixture.

metrics.name: VERTICAL_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean((z_meas-z_ref)^2)) in frozen local frame
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=VERTICAL_POSITION; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known vertical residual fixture.

metrics.name: RANGE_ERROR_MAE

metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=RANGE; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known signed residual vector; compare MAE.

metrics.name: RANGE_ERROR_P50
metrics.formula: quantile(abs(measured_range-reference_range),0.50)
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=RANGE; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Deterministic residual set; verify median absolute error.

metrics.name: RANGE_ERROR_MAX_ABS
metrics.formula: max(abs(measured_range-reference_range))
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=RANGE; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known residual set with one valid maximum and one invalid outlier.

metrics.name: AZIMUTH_ERROR_P95

metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Wrapped-angle residual set; verify P95.

metrics.name: ELEVATION_ERROR_BIAS

metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known constant elevation bias.

metrics.name: ELEVATION_ERROR_P95

metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=ELEVATION; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known elevation residual set.

metrics.name: RADIAL_POSITION_ERROR_RMSE
