metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association valid; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=RADIAL_POSITION; units/frame known
metrics.na_conditions: no valid matched samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile with deterministic N/A reason
evidence: reference match quality profile id/version/hash + per-sample eligibility/rejection reason
metrics.golden_test: Known 3D error decomposed into radial/cross/vertical components.

metrics.name: TRACK_INITIATION_TIME
metrics.formula: Track initiation time = (stable_track_start_time_us-first_confirmed_detection_time_us)/1e6, where first_confirmed_detection_time_us comes from CONTRACT_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_EVENT_V1 and stable_track_start_time_us is produced by SM_TRACK_STABLE_V1 using stable_track_persistence_s/max_gap_us for the same authoritative reference association.
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical confirmation event, track validity and authoritative association resolved; timestamps aligned; stable-track onset satisfies declared persistence/gap rule
metrics.na_conditions: confirmation event/association/track validity unavailable or no stable-track onset satisfying the declared persistence/gap rule
metrics.golden_test: Known 1.5 s initiation; unstable provisional track excluded.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes dependency on aggregate P1-SNS-003 output; event time comes from canonical Confirmation Contract.

metrics.name: TRACK_POSITION_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(||p_track-p_ref||^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical valid track states are authoritatively associated; matched reference position and Session-Time alignment available; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=POSITION_3D
metrics.na_conditions: no valid associated track/reference position samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved or all matched samples rejected by the profile
metrics.golden_test: Known track residual fixture.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 narrows eligibility/N_A to the dependencies actually consumed by this metric; detection opportunity is not an implicit prerequisite. ED-1.5.12 binds reference-quality eligibility to POSITION_3D through CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

metrics.name: TRACK_VELOCITY_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(||v_track-v_ref||^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical valid track states are authoritatively associated; matched reference velocity and Session-Time alignment available; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=VELOCITY_3D
metrics.na_conditions: no valid associated track/reference velocity samples; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved or all matched samples rejected by the profile
metrics.golden_test: Known velocity residual fixture.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 narrows eligibility/N_A to the dependencies actually consumed by this metric; detection opportunity is not an implicit prerequisite. ED-1.5.12 binds reference-quality eligibility to VELOCITY_3D through CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

metrics.name: TRACK_CONTINUITY
metrics.formula: duration(canonical valid track ∩ canonical opportunity)/duration(canonical opportunity) using CONTRACT_TRACK_VALIDITY_V1 and CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 for the same authoritative association
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical opportunity interval, track validity and authoritative association resolved with matching evaluated system/reference entity and opportunity profile provenance
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity contract/profile unavailable or no valid opportunities; track validity/association unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Known intervals with gap; exact ratio.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 consumes canonical opportunity intervals/profile provenance; Track Metric does not rebuild opportunity eligibility.

metrics.name: TRACK_DROP_COUNT
metrics.formula: Within canonical CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 intervals, count one drop when authoritative track validity transitions VALID→INVALID for the same association and invalid dwell lasts at least drop_min_duration_s. A continuous invalid dwell counts once.
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical opportunity interval, track validity and authoritative association resolved; drop_min_duration_s resolved
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity contract/profile unavailable or no valid opportunities; track validity/association unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Interval fixture with short glitch and two true drops.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 consumes canonical opportunity intervals/profile provenance; Track Metric does not rebuild opportunity eligibility. ED-1.5.12 freezes exact profile.<parameter> input-field names; generic profile aliases are forbidden.

metrics.name: TRACK_REACQUISITION_TIME
metrics.formula: Within canonical CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 intervals and using SM_TRACK_DROP_REACQUIRE_V1, a drop qualifies only when invalid dwell>=drop_min_duration_s. reacquisition_delay=reacquired_stable_track_time_us-track_drop_start_time_us, where same-association validity persists for reacquisition_persistence_s. Primary Metric value=MEDIAN_V1(qualified reacquisition_delay); QUANTILE_HF7_V1 P95 is mandatory diagnostic Evidence.
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical opportunity interval, track validity and authoritative association resolved; drop/reacquisition parameters resolved
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity contract/profile unavailable or no valid opportunities/qualified drops; track validity/association unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Fixture with known two reacquisition delays.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 selects median reacquisition delay as scalar primary value; P95 remains evidence. semantic_version increments.

metrics.name: TRACK_AGE
metrics.formula: track_age_s=(track_state_time_us-last_measurement_effective_time_us)/1e6. Primary Metric value=MEDIAN_V1(track_age_s) over eligible canonical valid-track samples; QUANTILE_HF7_V1 P95 and max(track_age_s) are mandatory diagnostic Evidence.
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical valid associated track state and last contributing measurement effective time are available on the same Session-Time basis
metrics.na_conditions: no valid associated track state or last contributing measurement effective time unavailable
evidence: last contributing measurement effective time provenance
metrics.golden_test: Known propagated track ages.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 selects median track age as scalar primary value; P95/max remain evidence. semantic_version increments.

metrics.name: ASSOCIATION_ACCURACY
metrics.formula: correct_association_duration / associated_duration
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association relation resolved for the eligible interval; required persistence/gap parameters resolved when declared
metrics.na_conditions: authoritative association relation unavailable/unresolved or no eligible associated dwell
metrics.golden_test: Known mapping intervals with one wrong segment.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes an unnecessary reference-classification prerequisite from association/identity-timeline metrics.

metrics.name: WRONG_ASSOCIATION_COUNT
metrics.formula: count distinct qualified wrong-association episodes
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association relation resolved for the eligible interval; required persistence/gap parameters resolved when declared
metrics.na_conditions: authoritative association relation unavailable/unresolved or no eligible associated dwell
metrics.golden_test: Known 2 wrong episodes separated by correct interval.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes an unnecessary reference-classification prerequisite from association/identity-timeline metrics.

metrics.name: TRACK_SWAP_COUNT
metrics.formula: Count a track-swap event when two live track IDs exchange their associated reference_target_id assignments and the exchanged assignment persists for at least swap_persistence_s. One continuous exchanged interval counts once.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association relation resolved for the eligible interval; required persistence/gap parameters resolved when declared
metrics.na_conditions: authoritative association relation unavailable/unresolved or no eligible associated dwell
metrics.golden_test: Two-target synthetic swap event.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes an unnecessary reference-classification prerequisite from association/identity-timeline metrics.

metrics.name: TRACK_SPLIT_COUNT
metrics.formula: Count one split event when a single reference_target_id is simultaneously represented by more than one distinct track_id continuously for at least split_persistence_s; one continuous multi-track episode counts once.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association relation resolved for the eligible interval; required persistence/gap parameters resolved when declared
metrics.na_conditions: authoritative association relation unavailable/unresolved or no eligible associated dwell
metrics.golden_test: Single truth target duplicated into two tracks.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes an unnecessary reference-classification prerequisite from association/identity-timeline metrics.

metrics.name: TRACK_MERGE_COUNT
metrics.formula: Count a merge event when two or more distinct reference targets are simultaneously represented by one track ID continuously for at least merge_persistence_s. One continuous merged interval counts once.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association relation resolved for the eligible interval; required persistence/gap parameters resolved when declared
metrics.na_conditions: authoritative association relation unavailable/unresolved or no eligible associated dwell
metrics.golden_test: Two truth targets merged into one track.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes an unnecessary reference-classification prerequisite from association/identity-timeline metrics.

metrics.name: DUPLICATE_TRACK_RATIO
metrics.formula: Under SM_ASSOCIATION_EPISODE_V1, a duplicate episode exists when more than one distinct track_id represents the same reference_target_id continuously for at least duplicate_persistence_s. duplicate_track_ratio=total duplicate-episode dwell/eligible associated target-present dwell.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association relation resolved for the eligible interval; required persistence/gap parameters resolved when declared
metrics.na_conditions: authoritative association relation unavailable/unresolved or no eligible associated dwell
metrics.golden_test: Known duplicate dwell interval.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes duplicate persistence and denominator. ED-1.5.12 removes an unnecessary reference-classification prerequisite from association/identity-timeline metrics.

metrics.name: TRACK_IDENTITY_CONTINUITY
metrics.formula: Within eligible associated target-present time governed by SM_ASSOCIATION_EPISODE_V1, an identity segment is continuous only while the same track_id represents the same reference_target_id with no gap > max_gap_us. Segments shorter than identity_persistence_s are not eligible. identity_continuity=longest eligible continuous identity dwell/eligible associated target-present duration.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association relation resolved for the eligible interval; required persistence/gap parameters resolved when declared
metrics.na_conditions: authoritative association relation unavailable/unresolved or no eligible associated dwell
metrics.golden_test: Target represented by same ID except one persistent switch.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 closes identity persistence/gap semantics. ED-1.5.12 removes an unnecessary reference-classification prerequisite from association/identity-timeline metrics.

metrics.name: IDENTIFICATION_ACCURACY
metrics.formula: Normalize reported_classification and reference_classification with REFERENCE_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY_CONTRACT_V1. Over authoritative association intervals where canonical reference label!=UNKNOWN and canonical reported label!=UNKNOWN, primary Metric value identification_accuracy=correct canonical-label dwell/classified eligible dwell. The canonical taxonomy confusion matrix is mandatory Evidence, not an additional Metric value.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association resolved; authoritative reference classification interval available; taxonomy_id/version/hash resolved; reported label normalizable through the same taxonomy
metrics.na_conditions: reference classification/taxonomy unavailable or unresolved; association unresolved; reference label quality invalid
metrics.golden_test: Multi-class confusion fixture.

metrics.name: FALSE_IDENTIFICATION_RATE
metrics.formula: Normalize both labels with REFERENCE_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY_CONTRACT_V1. Over authoritative association intervals where canonical reference label != UNKNOWN and canonical reported label != UNKNOWN: false_identification_rate = incorrect canonical-label dwell / classified eligible dwell. UNKNOWN reports are excluded from this denominator and are measured by the separate UNKNOWN_DWELL_RATIO metric.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association resolved; authoritative reference classification interval available; taxonomy_id/version/hash resolved; reported label normalizable through the same taxonomy
metrics.na_conditions: reference classification/taxonomy unavailable or unresolved; association unresolved; reference label quality invalid
metrics.golden_test: Known false-class dwell.

metrics.name: UNKNOWN_DWELL_RATIO
metrics.formula: UNKNOWN dwell / eligible track dwell
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association relation resolved for the eligible interval; required persistence/gap parameters resolved when declared
metrics.na_conditions: authoritative association relation unavailable/unresolved or no eligible associated dwell
metrics.golden_test: Known UNKNOWN segments.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes an unnecessary reference-classification prerequisite from association/identity-timeline metrics.

metrics.name: IDENTIFICATION_LATENCY
metrics.formula: Normalize reported/reference labels with REFERENCE_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY_CONTRACT_V1. identification_latency_s=(first SM_IDENTIFICATION_STABLE_V1 correct non-UNKNOWN canonical identification time-stable_track_start_time_us)/1e6 for the same authoritative association. SM_TRACK_STABLE_V1 uses stable_track_persistence_s/max_gap_us; SM_IDENTIFICATION_STABLE_V1 uses id_stability_persistence_s/max_gap_us.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association and reference classification/taxonomy resolved; stable_track_start_time_us produced by SM_TRACK_STABLE_V1 under stable_track_persistence_s/max_gap_us; reported label normalizable through the same taxonomy
metrics.na_conditions: reference classification/taxonomy unavailable or unresolved; association unresolved; reference label quality invalid
metrics.golden_test: Known classification transition timeline.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes track/ID stability criteria.

metrics.name: IDENTIFICATION_STABILITY
metrics.formula: Normalize labels with REFERENCE_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY_CONTRACT_V1. After the first SM_IDENTIFICATION_STABLE_V1 correct non-UNKNOWN canonical identification, primary Metric value identification_stability=stable_correct_canonical_classified_dwell/post_identification_eligible_dwell for the same authoritative association. Canonical-label transition_count is mandatory Evidence. SM_IDENTIFICATION_STABLE_V1 uses id_stability_persistence_s/max_gap_us from the declared Evaluation Profile.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative association resolved; authoritative reference classification interval available; taxonomy_id/version/hash resolved; reported label normalizable through the same taxonomy
metrics.na_conditions: reference classification/taxonomy unavailable or unresolved; association unresolved; reference label quality invalid
metrics.golden_test: Correct→wrong→correct classification timeline.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes identification stability persistence/gap.

metrics.name: PASSIVE_LOS_ANGULAR_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(acos(clamp(u_meas·u_ref,-1,1))^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: system_type in {'IRST','EO'}; reference state/association/timing valid; matched sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=LOS_ANGLE
metrics.na_conditions: system_type not in {'IRST','EO'}; passive measurement/reference unavailable; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected
metrics.golden_test: Known angular offsets.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 binds reference-quality eligibility to LOS_ANGLE through CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

metrics.name: PASSIVE_LOS_RATE_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean((los_rate_meas-los_rate_ref)^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: system_type in {'IRST','EO'}; reference state/association/timing valid; matched sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=LOS_RATE
metrics.na_conditions: system_type not in {'IRST','EO'}; passive measurement/reference unavailable; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected
metrics.golden_test: Known LOS-rate residuals.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 binds reference-quality eligibility to LOS_RATE through CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

metrics.name: PASSIVE_RANGE_ESTIMATE_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean((range_est-range_ref)^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: system_type in {'IRST','EO'}; reference state/association/timing valid; matched sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=RANGE
metrics.na_conditions: system_type not in {'IRST','EO'}; passive measurement/reference unavailable; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected
metrics.golden_test: Known passive range estimates.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 binds reference-quality eligibility to RANGE through CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

metrics.name: PASSIVE_DETECTION_RATE
metrics.formula: detected confirmed passive opportunity count / valid passive opportunity count, using only CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 and CONTRACT_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_EVENT_V1 events for the same reference association
metrics.validity_conditions: system_type in {'IRST','EO'}; canonical passive opportunity intervals and confirmation events resolved; authoritative association and Session-Time alignment valid
metrics.na_conditions: system_type not in {'IRST','EO'}; no valid passive opportunity; opportunity/confirmation contract unresolved; or passive source unavailable
metrics.golden_test: Known opportunity/detection fixture.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 consumes canonical opportunity intervals with frozen profile provenance; the metric does not reconstruct opportunity eligibility.

metrics.name: PASSIVE_TRACK_CONTINUITY
metrics.formula: duration(valid passive track ∩ canonical passive opportunity)/duration(canonical passive opportunity) using CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1
metrics.validity_conditions: system_type in {'IRST','EO'}; canonical passive opportunity intervals, track validity, association and Session-Time alignment resolved
metrics.na_conditions: system_type not in {'IRST','EO'}; no valid passive opportunity; or track/association contract unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Known passive track gaps.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 consumes canonical opportunity intervals with frozen profile provenance; the metric does not reconstruct opportunity eligibility.

metrics.name: PASSIVE_REACQUISITION_TIME
metrics.formula: For passive tracks use SM_TRACK_DROP_REACQUIRE_V1 with drop_min_duration_s/reacquisition_persistence_s/max_gap_us. Primary Metric value=MEDIAN_V1(reacquisition_delay) measured from qualified drop start to stable same-association reacquisition; QUANTILE_HF7_V1 P95 is mandatory diagnostic Evidence.
metrics.validity_conditions: system_type in {'IRST','EO'}; track-validity timeline and authoritative same-target association resolved; drop/reacquisition state machine receives continuous Session-Time input subject to max_gap_us
metrics.na_conditions: system_type not in {'IRST','EO'}; track/association unavailable; or no qualified drop/reacquisition event
metrics.golden_test: Known passive reacquisition delays.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 selects median passive reacquisition delay as scalar primary value; P95 remains evidence. semantic_version increments.

metrics.name: PASSIVE_FALSE_TRACK_RATE
metrics.formula: Among passive tracks qualified by SM_TRACK_STABLE_V1, false_track_rate = count(stable tracks with no valid CONTRACT_ASSOCIATION_RELATION_V1 association) / count(stable qualified passive tracks). Stability uses stable_track_persistence_s/max_gap_us; no geometry-only association is inferred inside this metric.
metrics.validity_conditions: system_type in {'IRST','EO'}; reference_target_coverage_status=COMPLETE for the entire evaluated interval; track stability and authoritative association relation resolved
metrics.na_conditions: system_type not in {'IRST','EO'}; reference target-set coverage is PARTIAL/UNKNOWN or does not span the full evaluated interval; or track/association unavailable
metrics.golden_test: Fixture with 10 qualified tracks, 2 unassociated false tracks and one excluded ambiguous track.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes passive-track qualification and association authority.

metrics.name: EMITTER_DETECTION_RATE
metrics.formula: confirmed detected emitter-opportunity count / valid emitter-opportunity count using CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 and CONTRACT_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_EVENT_V1; observed detection outcome never defines the opportunity denominator
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical emitter opportunity intervals and confirmed-detection events resolved; authoritative emitter association and Session-Time alignment valid
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity contract unavailable/no valid emitter opportunities; confirmation contract unresolved; or ESM source absent
metrics.golden_test: Known emitter on/off timeline and detections.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 consumes canonical opportunity intervals with frozen profile provenance; the metric does not reconstruct opportunity eligibility.

metrics.name: EMITTER_BEARING_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(wrap_pi(reported-reference)^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: reference emitter state/time valid; ESM timestamps aligned; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=BEARING
metrics.na_conditions: reference emitter activity unavailable or ESM source absent; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved or all matched samples rejected by the profile
metrics.golden_test: Bearing wrap fixture.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 binds reference-quality eligibility to BEARING through CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

metrics.name: EMITTER_DETECTION_LATENCY
metrics.formula: detection_latency_s=(first_confirmed_detection_time_us-opportunity_start_time_us)/1e6 using one CONTRACT_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_EVENT_V1 event inside its CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 interval
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical emitter opportunity and confirmed-detection event resolved for the same reference emitter association; Session-Time aligned
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity/confirmation contract unavailable, no confirmed detection inside a valid opportunity, or ESM source absent
metrics.golden_test: Known activation and detection delay.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 consumes canonical opportunity/confirmation contracts; no hidden confirmation persistence is rerun in this metric.

metrics.name: EMITTER_ASSOCIATION_ACCURACY
metrics.formula: correct association dwell / associated dwell
metrics.validity_conditions: reference emitter state/time valid; ESM timestamps aligned
metrics.na_conditions: reference emitter activity unavailable or ESM source absent
metrics.golden_test: Known correct/wrong emitter mapping intervals.

metrics.name: EMITTER_CLASSIFICATION_ACCURACY
metrics.formula: Normalize reported_emitter_class and authoritative reference_emitter_class with REFERENCE_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY_CONTRACT_V1. Over authoritative emitter-association intervals where canonical reference label!=UNKNOWN and canonical reported label!=UNKNOWN, primary Metric value emitter_classification_accuracy=correct canonical-label dwell/classified eligible dwell. The canonical taxonomy confusion matrix is mandatory Evidence, not an additional Metric value.
metrics.validity_conditions: authoritative emitter reference/association interval available; taxonomy_id/version/hash resolved; reported label normalizable through the same taxonomy; Session-Time aligned
metrics.na_conditions: reference emitter classification/taxonomy unavailable or unresolved; association unresolved; reference label quality invalid; or no classified eligible dwell
metrics.golden_test: Known emitter-class confusion fixture.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes emitter classification authority/taxonomy normalization and UNKNOWN handling.

metrics.name: EMITTER_TRACK_CONTINUITY
metrics.formula: duration(valid ESM track ∩ canonical emitter opportunity)/duration(canonical emitter opportunity) using CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical emitter opportunity intervals, ESM track validity, association and Session-Time alignment resolved
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity contract unavailable/no valid emitter opportunities or ESM track/association unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Known ESM track gaps during active emitter.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 consumes canonical opportunity intervals with frozen profile provenance; the metric does not reconstruct opportunity eligibility.

metrics.name: MESSAGE_LATENCY
metrics.formula: (receive-send)/1e6
metrics.validity_conditions: send/receive timestamps resolved to Session Time through CONTRACT_TIME_TRANSFORM_V1; link endpoint identity known; receive_time >= send_time
metrics.na_conditions: send/receive timestamp, TimeTransform, or link endpoint identity unavailable/invalid
metrics.golden_test: Known timestamp pairs including invalid negative latency rejection.

metrics.name: MESSAGE_JITTER
metrics.formula: Within one continuous message-validity piece containing at least min_message_count messages and no gap > max_gap_us, compute message_latency_us. message_jitter_us=MAD_V1(message_latency_us). QUANTILE_HF7_V1 P95-P50 latency spread is retained only as diagnostic evidence and is not an alternative metric formula.
metrics.validity_conditions: latency samples satisfy P1-DL-001 timestamp/link validity; sample count >= min_message_count; no internal gap > max_gap_us
metrics.na_conditions: insufficient valid latency samples; sample count < min_message_count; or gap > max_gap_us
metrics.golden_test: Known latency sequence and MAD.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 closes minimum-count/gap qualification.

metrics.name: MESSAGE_LOSS_RATE
metrics.formula: Within each canonical sequence_epoch_id governed by SM_DATALINK_SEQUENCE_EPOCH_V1, expected_count is derived from the declared expected_sequence_domain/modulus and observed ordered sequence positions. message_loss_rate = missing_expected_positions / expected_positions. Do not infer a reset from arbitrary backward jumps; modulo wrap remains inside the epoch.
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical sequence_epoch_id/domain/modulus resolved; link endpoint identity known
metrics.na_conditions: sequence epoch/domain/modulus or link endpoint identity unavailable
metrics.golden_test: Sequence fixture with reset and two true losses.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes reset/epoch handling.

metrics.name: OUT_OF_ORDER_RATE
metrics.formula: Within each canonical sequence_epoch_id from CONTRACT_TDL_SEQUENCE_EPOCH_V1 / SM_DATALINK_SEQUENCE_EPOCH_V1, out_of_order_rate = out_of_order_received_messages / received_messages. Epoch boundaries are authoritative; the metric must not infer resets from arbitrary backward sequence jumps.
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical sequence_epoch_id and receive order resolved; link endpoint identity known
metrics.na_conditions: sequence epoch/receive order or link endpoint identity unavailable
metrics.golden_test: Known reorder sequence.

metrics.name: REMOTE_TRACK_AGE
metrics.formula: remote_track_age_s=(local_use_time_us-remote_track_effective_time_us)/1e6
metrics.validity_conditions: remote_track_effective_time_us and local_use_time_us resolved to Session Time; remote track validity known; link endpoint identity known
metrics.na_conditions: remote effective/local use time, track-validity state, or link endpoint identity unavailable
metrics.golden_test: Known age values.

metrics.name: REMOTE_TRACK_POSITION_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(||p_remote-p_ref||^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: remote track validity and authoritative target association resolved; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=POSITION_3D; link endpoint identity known
metrics.na_conditions: remote track/reference/association unavailable; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile
metrics.golden_test: Known remote-track position residuals.

metrics.name: REMOTE_TRACK_VELOCITY_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(||v_remote-v_ref||^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: remote track validity and authoritative target association resolved; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=VELOCITY_3D; link endpoint identity known
metrics.na_conditions: remote track/reference/association unavailable; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved; or all matched samples rejected by the profile
metrics.golden_test: Known remote velocity residuals.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 corrects the eligibility uncertainty domain from RADIAL_VELOCITY to VELOCITY_3D to match the 3D velocity-vector RMSE formula.

metrics.name: REMOTE_TRACK_CONTINUITY
metrics.formula: duration(valid remote track ∩ canonical remote-track opportunity)/duration(canonical remote-track opportunity) using CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical remote-track opportunity intervals, remote track validity, authoritative target association and link endpoint identity resolved
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity contract unavailable/no valid remote-track opportunities or remote track/association unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Known remote track gaps.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 consumes canonical opportunity intervals with frozen profile provenance; the metric does not reconstruct opportunity eligibility.

metrics.name: FUSED_POSITION_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(||p_fused-p_ref||^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical fused track is valid; fusion provenance/source membership and authoritative target association resolved; matched reference position and timestamps available; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=POSITION_3D
metrics.na_conditions: no valid fused/reference position samples or fusion provenance/association unresolved; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved or all matched samples rejected by the profile
metrics.golden_test: Known fused-track position residuals.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes generic handover/reference prerequisites and freezes metric-specific eligibility/N_A evidence. ED-1.5.12 binds reference-quality eligibility to POSITION_3D through CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

metrics.name: FUSED_VELOCITY_ERROR_RMSE
metrics.formula: sqrt(mean(||v_fused-v_ref||^2))
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical fused track is valid; fusion provenance/source membership and authoritative target association resolved; matched reference velocity and timestamps available; matched reference sample passes CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1 for error_domain=VELOCITY_3D
metrics.na_conditions: no valid fused/reference velocity samples or fusion provenance/association unresolved; reference-match quality profile absent/unresolved or all matched samples rejected by the profile
metrics.golden_test: Known fused velocity residuals.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes generic handover/reference prerequisites and freezes metric-specific eligibility/N_A evidence. ED-1.5.12 binds reference-quality eligibility to VELOCITY_3D through CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

metrics.name: FUSION_LATENCY
metrics.formula: For each fused update, SM_FUSION_CAUSAL_MATCH_V1 selects the latest causally eligible source update referenced by frozen fusion provenance. fusion_latency_s=(fused_state_effective_time_us-source_update_effective_time_us)/1e6. Geometry-only re-association is forbidden inside this metric.
metrics.applicable_window: fused-update windows with resolved causal source provenance
metrics.validity_conditions: fusion provenance/source membership available; fused/source effective timestamps resolved to Session Time; causal source update resolved by SM_FUSION_CAUSAL_MATCH_V1
metrics.na_conditions: fusion provenance unavailable, source update unresolved, or effective timestamps not alignable to Session Time
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic source update followed by delayed fused update.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 freezes causal source-update matching. ED-1.5.12 removes generic handover/reference prerequisites and freezes metric-specific eligibility/N_A evidence.

metrics.name: FUSED_TRACK_CONTINUITY
metrics.formula: duration(valid fused track ∩ canonical fused opportunity)/duration(canonical fused opportunity) using CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical fused opportunity intervals, fusion provenance, fused track validity and authoritative target association resolved
metrics.na_conditions: opportunity contract unavailable/no valid fused opportunities or fusion provenance/track validity/association unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Known fused track gaps.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes generic handover/reference prerequisites and freezes metric-specific eligibility/N_A evidence. ED-1.5.12 consumes canonical opportunity intervals with frozen profile provenance; the metric does not reconstruct opportunity eligibility.

metrics.name: DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSION_RATE
metrics.formula: A duplicate interval exists when more than one fused track is simultaneously associated with the same reference target continuously for at least duplicate_persistence_s. duplicate_suppression_rate = 1 - duplicate_fused_track_dwell / eligible_target_dwell.
metrics.validity_conditions: fusion provenance and authoritative association timeline available; eligible associated target-present dwell resolved; timestamps aligned
metrics.na_conditions: fusion provenance/association unavailable or no eligible associated target-present dwell
metrics.golden_test: Two source tracks same truth fused into one except one duplicate interval.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes generic handover/reference prerequisites and freezes metric-specific eligibility/N_A evidence.

metrics.name: FUSION_ASSOCIATION_ACCURACY
metrics.formula: correct source-to-truth membership dwell / fused associated dwell
metrics.validity_conditions: fusion source membership/provenance and authoritative source/target association intervals available; timestamps aligned
metrics.na_conditions: fusion provenance/association unavailable or no eligible fused associated dwell
metrics.golden_test: Known fusion membership with one wrong source association.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 removes generic handover/reference prerequisites and freezes metric-specific eligibility/N_A evidence.

metrics.name: TRACK_HANDOVER_CONTINUITY
metrics.formula: handover_continuity=count(canonical qualified CONTRACT_FUSION_HANDOVER_EVENT_V1 events with identity_preserved=true)/count(all canonical qualified handover events). Qualification/persistence/gap and source-membership change are owned by WRE event construction, not this Metric.
metrics.validity_conditions: at least one canonical qualified handover event with frozen profile/provenance and authoritative reference association
metrics.na_conditions: no canonical qualified handover event or handover-event provenance/association unresolved
metrics.golden_test: Radar→radar+IRST→IRST handover with one identity break.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 final closure moves handover state-machine ownership to the WRE canonical event builder.

metrics.name: TRACK_HANDOVER_JUMP
metrics.formula: For each canonical qualified CONTRACT_FUSION_HANDOVER_EVENT_V1, propagate the last pre-handover fused position to handover_time_us with CV_PROPAGATION_V1 only when handover_time_us-pre_handover_state_time_us<=max_propagation_age_us: p_pred=p_before+v_before*dt. track_handover_jump_m=||p_after-p_pred||. Velocity discontinuity is not part of this metric.
metrics.applicable_window: qualified fusion handover events with propagatable pre-handover state
metrics.validity_conditions: canonical qualified handover event resolved; pre/post fused states and pre-handover velocity valid; propagation age <=max_propagation_age_us
metrics.na_conditions: handover event absent/unresolved; required fused state/velocity unavailable; or propagation age exceeds max_propagation_age_us
metrics.golden_test: Synthetic source handover with known 120 m discontinuity.
metrics.notes: ED-1.5.12 final closure consumes canonical handover event directly; no dependency on P1-FUS-007 scalar/result or local handover state machine.

DERIVATIVE_LLS_V1.definition: Within one validity piece, estimate first derivative as the slope of an ordinary least-squares fit y=a+b*t over a centered/edge-clipped window of derivative_window_s; timestamps use seconds relative to window origin; require at least 3 distinct timestamps; never include samples across max_gap_us or validity-piece boundaries.

ROLLING_MEDIAN_V1.definition: Time-based centered rolling median over sustain_duration_s inside one validity piece. A window is eligible only when valid covered duration / sustain_duration_s >= min_coverage and no internal gap exceeds max_gap_us.

MEDIAN_V1.definition: Arithmetic sample median after validity filtering; for even N use the mean of the two central sorted values.

QUANTILE_HF7_V1.definition: Hyndman-Fan type 7 linear-interpolated sample quantile on validity-filtered finite samples.

RMS_V1.definition: sqrt(arithmetic mean(x^2)) over validity-filtered finite samples.

BANDPASS_BUTTERWORTH4_ZP_V1.definition: For each SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1 independently, resample the finite source angle with LINEAR_INTERPOLATION_V1 onto a uniform grid t_k=t_first+k/resample_rate_hz, retaining only grid points <=t_last and never bridging max_gap_us. Require 0<low_hz<high_hz<resample_rate_hz/2. Design a 4th-order Butterworth band-pass from the analog Butterworth prototype with -3 dB edges low_hz/high_hz, frequency-prewarped for the bilinear transform at resample_rate_hz, and realize it as a double-precision second-order-section cascade. Before each forward/reverse pass, pad each end by odd reflection of exactly ceil(filter_padding_s*resample_rate_hz) samples; require the unpadded grid to contain more samples than the pad count and at least ceil(min_window_s*resample_rate_hz) samples. Run the SOS cascade forward with zero initial state, reverse the padded forward output and run the same cascade again with zero initial state, reverse back, then discard reflected padding. No library default pad length, implicit resampling, extrapolation, or alternate filter design is permitted.

THEIL_SEN_GAIN_V1.definition: Median of all pairwise slopes delta_response/delta_command between distinct eligible command levels within one isolated event.

GEODESIC_PAIR_RATE_V1.definition: For consecutive unit vectors b0,b1, theta=atan2(||b0×b1||,clamp(b0·b1,-1,1)); rate=theta/dt; no smoothing.

LINEAR_INTERPOLATION_V1.definition: Piecewise linear interpolation between bracketing finite samples inside the same validity piece; never extrapolate and never bridge max_gap_us.

CV_PROPAGATION_V1.definition: Constant-velocity propagation p(t1)=p(t0)+v(t0)*(t1-t0), only when propagation age <= max_propagation_age_us.

MEAN_V1.definition: Arithmetic mean=sum(x_i)/N over validity-filtered finite samples using deterministic double-precision accumulation in source Session-Time order; N must be >=1.

G0_MPS2.definition: Standard gravitational acceleration used by P1 observed-energy metrics.

ENERGY_DENOM_EPS_J_PER_KG.definition: Numerical denominator guard only; values at or below this magnitude are ineligible, not clamped.

ENERGY_RATE_EPS_W_PER_KG.definition: Numerical positive-energy-rate guard only; values at or below this magnitude are not treated as positive.

FUEL_BURN_RATE_EPS_KG_S.definition: Numerical denominator guard for endurance proxy; values at or below this magnitude produce N_A/INSUFFICIENT_DATA rather than a clamped quotient.

SM_VALIDITY_PIECE_V1.definition: A maximal time interval with resolved Session Time, continuous required inputs, no source/TimeTransform discontinuity and no gap above the metric-declared max_gap_us. Metrics must not compute derivatives/rolling windows across piece boundaries.

SM_CLOCK_SEGMENT_V1.definition: A stable clock segment is one TimeTransform segment with fixed transform identity/revision, no unresolved clock reset, VALID fit status, and monotonically mapped Session Time. Segment boundaries split statistics.

SM_POST_MANEUVER_RECOVERY_WINDOW_V1.definition: Recovery window begins at the supplied maneuver_end_time_us and is clipped to the same validity piece and declared recovery horizon; it terminates at the first disqualifying mode/event boundary or validity break.

SM_COMMAND_RESPONSE_EVENT_V1.definition: Command/response event state machine defined by P1-AIR-027: command onset requires deadband crossing plus persistence; response onset requires same-sign threshold crossing plus persistence within max_search_s. Event identity and axis/mode remain fixed until event end.

SM_FUEL_QUANTITY_EVENT_V1.definition: Fuel derivative pieces are split at explicit source reset/refuel markers. If no explicit marker exists, a positive fuel_remaining jump >= refuel_jump_threshold_kg starts a REFUEL_OR_RESET event; samples inside event_guard_s before/after the jump are excluded. Smaller positive noise does not create an event.

SM_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_V1.definition: Opportunity is TRUE only while reference target/emitter exists, required reference quality passes, the evaluated system is in an enabled mode, its data stream is available, and declared geometry eligibility holds. Detection outcome never contributes to opportunity construction.

SM_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_V1.definition: Detection is confirmed when the same reference association or explicit detection state remains valid continuously for detection_confirmation_persistence_s inside one opportunity episode.

SM_TRACK_STABLE_V1.definition: A stable track starts when the same track_id and reference association remain VALID continuously for stable_track_persistence_s without a gap > max_gap_us; any association change, invalid state, or excessive gap ends stability.

SM_TRACK_DROP_REACQUIRE_V1.definition: A drop starts on VALID→INVALID within an opportunity and qualifies only if invalid dwell >= drop_min_duration_s. Reacquisition occurs when the same reference association becomes VALID and remains stable for reacquisition_persistence_s; delay is measured from drop start.

SM_ASSOCIATION_EPISODE_V1.definition: Association episodes consume the authoritative reference_target_id↔track_id relation. A continuous unchanged relation is one episode; relation change or invalid/unresolved relation ends the episode. Metrics must not infer association from geometry unless the upstream relation producer explicitly owns that algorithm.

SM_IDENTIFICATION_STABLE_V1.definition: Identification becomes stable when the same non-UNKNOWN classification for the same authoritative reference association persists for id_stability_persistence_s without a gap > max_gap_us. Any class/association change resets persistence.

SM_DATALINK_SEQUENCE_EPOCH_V1.definition: Message loss is computed only inside an explicit sequence_epoch_id produced by the canonical TDL parser. An epoch boundary is created by an explicit source/session reset marker; modulo sequence wrap within the declared expected_sequence_domain remains in the same epoch. The metric must not infer a reset from an arbitrary backward jump.

SM_FUSION_CAUSAL_MATCH_V1.definition: For one fused update, eligible source updates are those referenced by frozen fusion provenance, with effective_time <= fused effective time. Select the latest eligible source effective_time; ties use stable source-id/sequence ordering. No geometry-only re-association is performed inside the metric.

SM_FUSION_HANDOVER_V1.definition: A handover begins when the dominant/source-membership provenance changes while reference target and fused_track_id remain constant. It qualifies only if the new membership persists for handover_persistence_s and no invalid gap exceeds max_handover_gap_us.

CONTRACT_TIME_TRANSFORM_V1.definition: Authoritative source-clock→Session-Time mapping and clock-segment identity.

CONTRACT_REFERENCE_RELATIVE_STATE_V1.definition: Reference relative state and uncertainty from P1-QA-001/002 with immutable frame/provenance.

CONTRACT_ASSOCIATION_RELATION_V1.definition: Authoritative target↔measurement/track association relation with provenance and validity interval.

CONTRACT_TRACK_VALIDITY_V1.definition: Canonical track validity state and track identity timeline.

CONTRACT_TDL_SEQUENCE_EPOCH_V1.definition: Canonical sequence_epoch_id, sequence domain/modulus and explicit reset markers.

CONTRACT_MANEUVER_WINDOW_V1.definition: Explicit maneuver/recovery event interval supplied by Episode/Stage/Event builder; metric does not rediscover the maneuver.

CONTRACT_FUEL_EVENT_MARKER_V1.definition: Explicit source reset/refuel markers when available.

CONTRACT_EMITTER_REFERENCE_EVENT_V1.definition: Authoritative emitter-active/reference event stream with emitter identity, active interval, reference bearing/state, canonical reference_emitter_class when classification is evaluated, taxonomy_id/version/hash, Session-Time provenance and quality. ESM metrics consume this contract rather than reconstruct emitter truth or taxonomy ad hoc.

CONTRACT_REFERENCE_IDENTITY_CLASSIFICATI.definition: Authoritative reference identity/classification relation for P1 ID metrics. Each label has reference_entity_id, valid [start,end) interval, taxonomy_id/version/hash, canonical_label, source authority/provenance and quality status. The evaluated mission-system reported label is never an authority source. Alias normalization is performed only by the versioned taxonomy contract; absent/unresolved reference labels make dependent ID metrics N_A.

CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE.definition: Versioned eligibility contract for matching mission-system measurements/tracks to reference state. A complete profile instance MUST provide profile_id/version/hash, max_interpolation_age_us, accepted_reference_quality_statuses, max_sigma_by_error_domain, required_uncertainty_components and N/A reason mapping. Missing fields are forbidden; explicit null means no numeric cap for that domain. Metrics consume this contract rather than inventing hidden reference-quality thresholds.

CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_.definition: Authoritative derived detection-opportunity interval. Required instance fields: opportunity_id, evaluated_system_instance_id, reference_entity_id, start_session_time_us, end_session_time_us, opportunity_profile_id/version/hash, eligibility_reason/provenance. Opportunity construction uses reference presence/quality, evaluated-system operating state, data availability and declared geometry/profile; observed detection outcome is forbidden as an input.

CONTRACT_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_EVENT_V1.definition: Authoritative confirmed-detection event produced inside one CONTRACT_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_INTERVAL_V1 interval. Required fields: confirmation_event_id, opportunity_id, reference_entity_id, first_confirmed_detection_time_us, confirmation_profile_id/version/hash, confirmation_persistence_s and association/provenance. Consumers do not rerun confirmation with hidden thresholds.

CONTRACT_CONTROL_INPUT_CALIBRATION_V1.definition: Canonical control-command calibration provenance. For each roll/pitch/yaw/throttle command channel it freezes source channel id, canonical axis, engineering/normalized unit, affine scale and offset (identity allowed), polarity, valid [start,end) interval, calibration_id/version/hash and source provenance. Raw ADC/count values without this contract are ineligible for P1 control-response/handling metrics; a Metric Plugin must never re-fit or infer calibration.

CONTRACT_REFERENCE_TARGET_SET_COVERAGE_V.definition: Coverage certificate for the authoritative reference-target universe over an evaluation interval. It freezes coverage_id/version/hash, valid [start,end), authority/source provenance and coverage_status=COMPLETE|PARTIAL|UNKNOWN. Metrics that interpret an unassociated evaluated-system track as a false track require COMPLETE coverage for the full evaluated interval; PARTIAL/UNKNOWN makes that false-track metric N_A.

CONTRACT_NAV_UNCERTAINTY_REPRESENTATION_.definition: Canonical navigation/time uncertainty representation. Every uncertainty input is an immutable record with uncertainty_ref_id/version/hash, quantity/domain, representation_type=COVARIANCE|SIGMA_1D|TWO_SIDED_HARD_BOUND, numeric value or covariance, unit/frame when applicable, valid [start,end) interval, quality status and source authority/provenance. TWO_SIDED_HARD_BOUND ±b is converted deterministically to sigma=b/sqrt(3) or variance=b^2/3; Metric code may not invent or manually approve a fallback bound.

CONTRACT_CONTROL_RESPONSE_CHANNEL_MAP_V1.definition: Canonical command-to-response channel mapping. Each record freezes map_id/version/hash, control_axis, canonical response_channel, response_unit, response_polarity, valid mode(s), valid [start,end) interval and source provenance. Metrics that compare command and response consume this mapping; they may not choose p/q/r/acceleration channels heuristically.

CONTRACT_FUSION_HANDOVER_EVENT_V1.definition: Canonical fusion handover event emitted once by WRE using SM_FUSION_HANDOVER_V1 over frozen fusion provenance and authoritative association. Each event freezes handover_event_id, reference_target_id, pre_fused_track_id, post_fused_track_id, handover_time_us, pre/post source-membership sets, identity_preserved, handover_profile_id/version/hash, qualification status, valid interval and provenance. Metric Plugins consume the event and never rerun the handover state machine.

POLICY_QA_TIME_ALIGNMENT_V1.definition: Reference/time-quality metrics that consume mapped Session Time must bind the authoritative TimeTransform contract.

POLICY_QA_INTERPOLATION_V1.definition: Interpolation-age statistics operate on the authoritative reference-relative series and use frozen median/P95 operators.

POLICY_QA_ERROR_DECOMPOSITION_V1.definition: Measurement error decomposition consumes the frozen reference/alignment uncertainty producers.

POLICY_SENSOR_FIRST_DETECTION_V1.definition: Time to first detection consumes canonical opportunity/confirmed-detection events for the same authoritative association; it does not rerun confirmation thresholds.

POLICY_SENSOR_FIRST_DETECTION_RANGE_V1.definition: First-detection range consumes canonical confirmed-detection event time and interpolates authoritative reference range; it never consumes an aggregate first-detection Metric result.

POLICY_SENSOR_ACCURACY_ASSOCIATION_V1.definition: Sensor accuracy residuals require authoritative measurement↔target association, reference state/uncertainty and interpolation quality.

POLICY_TRACK_INIT_V1.definition: Track initiation consumes canonical confirmation event plus authoritative track/association timeline.

POLICY_TRACK_ACCURACY_V1.definition: Track accuracy requires valid associated tracks matched to the authoritative reference-relative state. Reference-match quality eligibility is governed by CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

POLICY_TRACK_CONTINUITY_V1.definition: Track continuity consumes canonical opportunity intervals and authoritative track/association state; it does not rebuild opportunity.

POLICY_TRACK_DROP_REACQUIRE_V1.definition: Drop/reacquisition consumes canonical opportunity interval and authoritative associated-track state; only drop/reacquisition state machine remains local to this algorithm contract.

POLICY_TRACK_AGE_V1.definition: Track age is computed only from canonical valid track states and their last contributing measurement time.

POLICY_PASSIVE_ACCURACY_V1.definition: Passive-sensor accuracy requires authoritative association and reference state/uncertainty/alignment quality. Reference-match quality eligibility is governed by CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

POLICY_PASSIVE_DETECTION_V1.definition: Passive detection rate uses canonical opportunity/confirmation contracts and authoritative association; the Metric does not recompute numeric reference state.

POLICY_PASSIVE_TRACK_V1.definition: Passive track metrics consume canonical track validity and authoritative association; numeric reference state is required only by passive accuracy metrics. P1-PSV-007 additionally requires COMPLETE reference-target-set coverage.

POLICY_ESM_REFERENCE_V1.definition: ESM metrics consume authoritative emitter reference events, identity association and Session-Time mapping.

POLICY_ESM_DETECTION_V1.definition: Emitter detection/latency use frozen opportunity and confirmation semantics.

POLICY_ESM_TRACK_V1.definition: Emitter track continuity requires canonical track validity inside the active opportunity.

POLICY_TDL_TIME_V1.definition: Message latency compares send/receive times only after authoritative time-base resolution.

POLICY_TDL_JITTER_V1.definition: Message jitter consumes the canonical message-latency series.

POLICY_TDL_SEQUENCE_V1.definition: Loss and out-of-order metrics operate only within canonical TDL sequence epochs.

POLICY_TDL_REMOTE_TRACK_AGE_V1.definition: Remote track age consumes canonical track validity and common Session-Time.

POLICY_TDL_REMOTE_TRACK_ACCURACY_V1.definition: Remote track accuracy requires authoritative track validity, association and target reference state.

POLICY_TDL_REMOTE_TRACK_CONTINUITY_V1.definition: Remote track continuity is evaluated against an associated target opportunity.

POLICY_FUSION_ACCURACY_V1.definition: Fused-state accuracy requires frozen fusion provenance, track validity, association and reference state. Reference-match quality eligibility is governed by CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE_V1.

POLICY_FUSION_LATENCY_V1.definition: Fusion latency uses frozen source provenance, Session-Time and causal-match state.

POLICY_FUSION_CONTINUITY_V1.definition: Fused track continuity requires authoritative provenance/track/association/reference contracts.

POLICY_FUSION_DUPLICATE_V1.definition: Duplicate suppression is defined over frozen fusion provenance, authoritative target association episodes and eligible associated target-present dwell; numeric reference kinematics are not a prerequisite.

POLICY_FUSION_ASSOCIATION_V1.definition: Fusion association accuracy consumes frozen source membership and authoritative source↔reference-target association; numeric reference kinematics are not a prerequisite.

POLICY_FUSION_HANDOVER_V1.definition: Fusion handover metrics consume the single canonical WRE handover-event contract. Metric Plugins do not execute SM_FUSION_HANDOVER_V1 and P1-FUS-008 never derives event authority from P1-FUS-007.

POLICY_ID_REFERENCE_CLASSIFICATION_V1.definition: Identification correctness/latency/stability requires authoritative target association plus versioned reference classification/taxonomy; evaluated-system reported labels cannot become reference truth.

POLICY_SENSOR_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_V1.definition: Every sensor-accuracy sample must pass the exact versioned/hash-frozen reference-match quality profile; hidden interpolation/uncertainty thresholds are prohibited.

POLICY_ID_ASSOCIATION_ONLY_V1.definition: Association/identity-timeline metrics require authoritative target↔track association but do not require a reference classification taxonomy unless their formula evaluates classification correctness.

POLICY_ESM_BEARING_QUALITY_V1.definition: Emitter bearing error is computed only on authoritative emitter-reference samples accepted by the versioned reference-match quality profile.

POLICY_ESM_CLASSIFICATION_V1.definition: Emitter classification accuracy requires authoritative emitter reference class plus the same versioned classification taxonomy for reference and reported labels.

POLICY_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_CONSUMER_V1.definition: Every Metric using an opportunity denominator/window or opportunity coverage consumes the canonical WRE opportunity interval with profile provenance. No Metric Plugin executes SM_DETECTION_OPPORTUNITY_V1.

POLICY_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_CONSUMER_V.definition: Every Metric consuming confirmed detection outcome/time consumes the canonical Confirmation Event and profile provenance. No Metric Plugin executes SM_DETECTION_CONFIRMATION_V1.

POLICY_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_ALL_ACCUR.definition: Every numeric mission-system error metric that compares an evaluated measurement/track/fused state with an authoritative numeric reference uses the same versioned reference-match quality eligibility contract and metric-specific error domain.

POLICY_SENSOR_OPPORTUNITY_COVERAGE_V1.definition: Detection Opportunity Coverage is a read-only view of canonical WRE opportunity intervals/profile provenance; Metric code never rebuilds opportunity eligibility.

POLICY_SENSOR_DETECTION_RATE_V1.definition: Detection Rate counts canonical opportunity intervals and canonical confirmation events; no Metric-local opportunity/confirmation state machine.

POLICY_CONTROL_INPUT_CALIBRATION_V1.definition: Every metric that interprets control magnitude, sign, rate, deadband or gain consumes the canonical versioned control-calibration contract; raw/source-scale inference inside Metric Plugins is prohibited.

POLICY_PASSIVE_FALSE_TRACK_COVERAGE_V1.definition: Passive false-track interpretation is valid only with COMPLETE authoritative reference-target-set coverage for the full evaluated interval.

POLICY_CONTROL_RESPONSE_CHANNEL_MAP_V1.definition: Every command-response metric resolves one canonical response channel/polarity through the versioned map; heuristic p/q/r/acceleration channel selection is forbidden.

POLICY_NAV_UNCERTAINTY_AUTHORITY_V1.definition: Navigation/time uncertainty consumers use only versioned uncertainty representation records; manual/approved fallback bounds are prohibited.

AIRCRAFT_CAP_L1_OBSERVATION.definition: Aircraft observed flight/manoeuvre/energy performance eligible for CAP_L1_OBSERVED publication.

SYSTEM_PERFORMANCE_OBSERVATION.definition: Mission-system observed performance/quality published against a stable mission_system_instance.

QUALITY_EVIDENCE_ONLY.definition: Reference/alignment/data-quality metric retained as release-bound metric instance/evidence/context only; it is not Aircraft CAP-L1 or System Performance observation.

CAPABILITY_OBSERVATION.definition: Publish release-bound metric_instance/evidence and build metric.capability_observation; may feed AIRCRAFT longitudinal samples.

SYSTEM_PERFORMANCE_OBSERVATION.definition: Publish release-bound metric_instance/evidence and build metric.system_performance_observation; may feed MISSION_SYSTEM_INSTANCE longitudinal samples.

REFERENCE_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY_CONTRA.definition: Schema/normalization contract for an versioned reference-classification taxonomy instance used by P1 target-identification and emitter-classification metrics.
normalization_rules: Every reference/reported label is normalized through the exact taxonomy_id/version/hash frozen in the metric evidence.
Alias resolution MUST be deterministic and one-to-one to a canonical label; an unmapped label resolves to unknown_label.
unknown_label is semantically UNKNOWN and is never silently treated as a correct non-UNKNOWN identification.
Label comparison occurs only after normalization; raw string equality is not authoritative across taxonomy versions.
Taxonomy instances with different taxonomy_hash are not comparable unless an explicit versioned bridge is supplied.

rules: The exact profile_id/version/hash is input provenance and MUST be persisted as reference_truth_profile_version/hash evidence.

A sample is eligible only when interpolation age <= max_interpolation_age_us, quality status is explicitly accepted, and every required uncertainty component is present and within the domain cap when that cap is non-null.
Rejected samples carry a deterministic reason from na_reason_map; rejected samples never enter numerator/denominator/statistics.
Profile values are configuration data, not algorithm choices; changing a profile segments comparison keys and does not silently mix samples.

P1-SNS-*.family_meaning: RADAR sensor detection and measurement layer; not generic sensor performance

P1-DL-*.family_meaning: datalink transport and remote-track delivery layer

P1-TRK-*.family_meaning: local track-processing product layer; applicability is by product capability, not by one physical sensor type

P1-ID-*.family_meaning: association/identity processing layer; applicability is by product capability

P1-QA-*.family_meaning: reference truth, uncertainty and time-alignment quality foundation
